hints.note: After looting an amulet the matching demon stops attacking and can't be re-attacked -- no need to avoid it afterward.

label: Search the half-soulless cage for Iban's dove
detail: Wear Klank's gauntlets first. Head north along the western ledge, across the first broken bridge, then north, east, north, and west to a dead-end cage; search it for the dove's remains, which auto-smear onto the doll.

label: Destroy Iban at the Well of the Damned
detail: Loot a disciple of Iban's Zamorak monk robes near the central temple and wear both pieces before entering. Iban attacks with recurring stun-spikes near the entrance; run in with full health and use the completed doll on the well at the centre as soon as possible (may take a few tries if his attacks interrupt you).

label: Report Iban's death to King Lathas
detail: Follow the now-sane Koftik back to the entrance, leave the cavern, and return to Ardougne Castle. All quest items are removed on completion -- drop any souvenirs first.

label: Talk to Vanstrom Klause (start In Search of the Myreque)
detail: Hair of the Dog tavern, Canifis, north-east corner. Agree to deliver weapons to the Myreque rebels; he mentions a boatman, Cyreg Paddlehorn, in Mort'ton.

refs.title: In Search of the Myreque/Quick guide

label: Fill the druid pouch with silver-sickled Mort myre fungus
detail: GATHER-NOT-GE FIX: the page's own item list offers 'buying from the Grand Exchange' as an alternative to collecting charges -- gather instead. Use a (blessed) Silver sickle (b) on fungus-covered logs in Mort Myre Swamp; each fill adds 3 charges to the druid pouch, so 6 fungus tops it to the 5+ charges needed.

refs.title: In Search of the Myreque/Quick guide

label: Travel to Mort'ton
detail: On foot through Mort Myre Swamp (ghasts drain druid pouch charges en route -- the extra fungus covers refills), or with 50+ Agility and fairy rings unlocked, ring code bip then the agility shortcut south of the swamp.

refs.title: In Search of the Myreque/Quick guide

label: Persuade Cyreg Paddlehorn to ferry you across
detail: Eastern edge of Mort'ton, by his boat at the Barrows bridge. With all five steel weapons and a 5+-charge druid pouch in your inventory, choose the four-step guilt-trip dialogue chain in order (own words: 'they'll die without weapons' -> 'resourceful enough for their own steel?' -> 'their deaths are on your head' -> 'what kind of man says that'). He asks for 3 planks to fix his boat and 3 more for a bridge, then ferries you to The Hollows for 10 coins (waived with a ring of charos (a)).

hints.note: Exact order matters; each response escalates the guilt angle.

refs.title: In Search of the Myreque/Quick guide

label: Repair the rope bridge into the Hollows
detail: North from the landing, avoiding ghasts, to a damaged rope bridge in a strange tree. Mend it while crossing with 3 planks and 225 steel nails (75 per plank), then climb down the far side.

refs.title: In Search of the Myreque/Quick guide

label: Answer Curpile Fyod's loyalty question
detail: North to the hollow tree. Tell Curpile you've brought weapons; he asks one randomised question to confirm you're telling the truth (own-words answer key: only female member = Sani Piliu; Mort Myre leader = Veliaf Hurtz; the boatman = Cyreg Paddlehorn; the scholar member = Polmafi Ferdygris; the youngest member = Ivan Strom; the ruling vampyre family = Drakan). A wrong answer knocks you out at the boat -- the bridge stays fixed and the pouch charge requirement is waived on retry.

hints.note: One of six possible questions, randomised per attempt.

refs.title: In Search of the Myreque/Quick guide

label: Introduce yourself to the five Myreque members
detail: Circle north to the hidden south-east alcove cave entrance. Talk to Veliaf first, then briefly greet each of the other five members ('I'll be back later' is enough -- no follow-up questions required).

refs.title: In Search of the Myreque/Quick guide

label: Kill the level-97 Skeleton Hellhound
detail: Return to Veliaf and hand over the five steel weapons -- a cutscene reveals Vanstrom Klause as a vampyre, who kills two members and summons a 55-HP hellhound (no Magic defence, weak to Earth). Kill it; there is a safespot in the upper-east corner behind the chair.

refs.title: In Search of the Myreque/Quick guide

label: Ask Veliaf how to leave the hideout
detail: He reveals a secret passage to Canifis.

refs.title: In Search of the Myreque/Quick guide

label: Exit via the secret passage to Canifis
detail: Search the wall at the end of the tunnel to open it, then climb the ladder up behind the Canifis tavern. Exiting via any other route requires a repeat trip to progress the quest.

refs.title: In Search of the Myreque/Quick guide

label: Talk to the Stranger in the tavern to finish
detail: Vanstrom is gone, replaced by a nondescript Stranger. Quest complete.

refs.title: In Search of the Myreque/Quick guide

label: Talk to King Narnode Shareen (start The Grand Tree)
detail: Ground floor of the Grand Tree, with 2 free inventory slots. He shows you the dying roots underground and gives a translation book and a bark sample, asking you to visit Hazelmere.

label: Travel to Hazelmere's house
detail: Small island east of Yanille, upstairs. Level-44 jungle spiders roam the path but are not poisonous.

label: Give Hazelmere the bark sample
detail: He examines the bark and gives back a message written in his own language.

label: Decode the message for King Narnode
detail: Use the translation book to decode Hazelmere's message ('a man came with the King's seal; I gave him Daconia rocks; Daconia rocks will kill the tree'). Select 'None of the above' for the first two dialogue prompts, then the three real lines in order. Narnode realises his seal was forged and sends you to his head tree guardian, Glough.

label: Talk to Glough
detail: Treehouse south of the Grand Tree, east of the balloon ramp. He dismisses humans as untrustworthy and says he'll handle it.

label: Talk to Charlie the prisoner
detail: Narnode reveals Glough imprisoned a human found with Daconia rocks. Top floor of the Grand Tree: Charlie says Glough paid him to steal from Hazelmere and suggests searching Glough's house.

label: Search Glough's cupboard for his journal
detail: The journal details a plan to frame humans as a threat to the tree gnomes. Confronting Glough with it gets you thrown into the cell beside Charlie's; Charlie gives the shipyard password 'Ka-Lu-Min'.

label: Escape to Karamja on the Gnome glider
detail: Narnode apologises and points you to the top-floor glider beside the cells. Ask the pilot to fly you to Karamja.

label: Get the lumber order from the Shipyard foreman
detail: The glider crash-lands west of the Shipyard. Run east past aggressive level-53 jogres; tell the gate worker Glough sent you plus the password. Talk to the level-23 foreman on the south docks, say Glough sent you, and answer his three personal questions (own-words key: his late wife -> 'Sadly his wife is no longer with us'; favourite dish -> 'He loves worm holes'; girlfriend's name -> 'Anita') to get a lumber order.

label: Sneak back into the Tree Gnome Stronghold
detail: Glough has barred the gate guards from letting you in. If Tree Gnome Village is done, use the Battlefield or Grand Exchange spirit tree instead. Otherwise talk to Femi by the gate -- free if never entered via the gate before, or if you helped her move boxes on first entry; 1,000 coins if you previously declined.

label: Show King Narnode the lumber order
detail: He still doubts you and sends you away for your own safety, but Charlie later mentions Glough's chest key is with his girlfriend Anita.

label: Fetch Glough's key from Anita and open his chest
detail: Climb the north-western-most ladder by the tortoise pens to talk to Anita for Glough's key. Use the key on the chest in Glough's house and click continue to receive his invasion plans.

label: Spell TUZO on the watchtower pillars
detail: Ensure 4 free inventory slots; bring the plans to King Narnode (still unconvinced, but gives 4 bundles of twigs). Climb the east watchtower in Glough's house (Agility 25) and use the twigs on the four pillars to spell TUZO (translation-book word for 'open'), starting from the far left. This unlocks the trapdoor -- do not descend until ready for the demon fight.

label: Kill the level-172 black demon
detail: Climb down; complete Glough's threatening dialogue in full without interacting with anything else, or you'll have to repeat it. The demon (40% weak to water spells, negative Magic defence) can be safespotted one tile north then east of the ladder. If not killed within 10 minutes it disappears and the fight must be restarted from the top-floor ladder.

hints.note: 10-minute timer resets the fight if not killed in time.

label: Search the roots for the last Daconia rock
detail: After the fight, a guard finds Glough hiding and Narnode apologises. Ensure 1 free inventory slot, then search the roots around the area until the rock turns up -- click continue to claim it.

label: Return the Daconia rock to King Narnode
detail: Quest complete.

label: Talk to Charlie (start Eagles' Peak)
detail: South-west part of Ardougne Zoo, south of the scorpion cage. He explains a delivered ferret escaped and the huntsman sent to recapture one, Nickolaus, has gone quiet; agree to look for him.

label: Travel to Eagles' Peak
detail: West of the Tree Gnome Stronghold. Fairy ring code AKQ is fastest, or a necklace of passage to the Outpost then north-west.

label: Read the bird book for the metal feather
detail: At the base tent, Nickolaus is missing. Inspect the books on the ground for a bird book; reading it shakes loose a metal feather.

label: Open the peak door and shout to Nickolaus
detail: Climb to the peak (south-side path, or the Agility shortcut beside the tent) to a feather-inscribed rock door; use the metal feather to open it. Inside, take the southern tunnel past the giant feathers to a ledge and shout to Nickolaus, trapped across a chasm by a giant eagle.

label: Gather 10 eagle feathers
detail: Piles of giant feathers spawn near where Nickolaus is trapped and throughout the cave.

label: Have Asyff sew two eagle disguises
detail: Fancy Dress Shop, south-east Varrock (gated area). Ask Asyff about bird costumes; she makes two eagle capes+beaks from the 10 giant feathers, swamp tar, yellow dye, and 50 coins.

label: Bring the disguises back to Nickolaus
detail: Return to the dungeon and shout to him again -- he asks for the disguises to be brought to the eagle door.

label: Free the bronze feather from its net trap
detail: West tunnel from the eagle door. Attempting to take the pedestal feather triggers a net trap; operate all four corner winches to break it, then take the feather.

label: Follow the trail and fight for the silver feather
detail: Second tunnel. Inspecting the empty pedestal (Hunter 27) reveals a partial trail; follow successive rock-heap inspections until a hidden tunnel is found. A level-13 kebbit attacks -- kill or threaten it for the silver feather (re-searchable from the tunnel if lost).

label: Solve the bird-seed lever puzzle for the gold feather
detail: North-east tunnel. Take bird seed from the holder near the entrance (need six placements total). Four levers move five metal eagles blocking the corridor west to the pedestal: centre lever moves east/north-west eagles, east lever moves the north-west eagle, south-west lever moves north-west/south eagles, north-west lever clears the corridor to the feather room. Fill feeders and pull levers in sequence to clear the path, then take the gold feather. A reset lever sits outside the chamber if the puzzle gets stuck.

label: Use all three feathers and disguise past the guard eagle
detail: Use the bronze, silver, and gold feathers on the eagle door to open it, then wear the full eagle disguise to walk past the guarding eagle to Nickolaus (skipping the disguise costs minor damage).

label: Talk to Nickolaus and agree to meet at camp
Learn to catch a ferret from Nickolaus
detail: Exit the dungeon and find Nickolaus back at the tent; he teaches the capture method (no box trap needed for this scripted catch -- if the ferret is released afterward, a real box trap he provides can recatch it).

label: Deliver the ferret to Charlie
detail: Ardougne Zoo. Quest complete.

label: Travel to the Abandoned Mine
detail: South-west Morytania, south of the swamp, west of Mort'ton/Burgh de Rott. Reach it via Nature Spirit access, a Mort'ton/Barrows teleport, or the Agility-25 low-fence shortcut from Burgh de Rott (needs partial In Aid of the Myreque).

label: Talk to the Saradominist zealot (start Haunted Mine)
detail: Wandering between the mine and the swamp. Pick any non-Zamorak response. He explains Treus Dayth, a Zamorakian mage bound to guard Salve-amulet crystals deep in the mine, and that he holds a key to a lower second entrance.

label: Pickpocket the zealot's key
detail: The key drops to the floor if your inventory is full.

label: Enter the Abandoned Mine
detail: Follow the cart track south past feral vampyres; climb over the mine cart (Agility 15) into the cart tunnel, or without 15 Agility use the southern entrance on the mountain's west side instead.

label: Navigate the upper cave levels to the level-3 ladder
detail: Dormant corpse-skeletons wake on approach, possessed pickaxes may attack when picked up, and self-moving carts damage on contact. Follow the cart track west, exit west, re-enter the southern entrance, ladder down, east then ladder down again, then time the north-south cart (wait for it to head south, follow, hide in the western alcove, then dash to the ladder when it returns north).

label: Pick a glowing fungus
detail: Stagnant pool west of the level-3 ladder. This is the only usable light source deeper in the mine -- never carry it outside the cave or drop it, both crumble it to ash.

label: Route the mine cart to the north-west ladder
detail: Place the fungus in the searchable cart north-west of the pool, then set the ten junction levers (A-E south-east of the control panel, F-J north around the corner; F/G/H are fixed/inaccessible) so the panel's route sends the cart to the top-right ladder. Press start; re-set levers and retry if it sinks or returns.

hints.note: Starting lever positions are randomised per player; the target route is fixed.

label: Retrieve the fungus at the north-west ladder
detail: Backtrack over the top of the mine, exit west, through the northern cave, down to the north-west corner ladder, and search the cart to reclaim the fungus that arrived.

label: Pick up a chisel (if not already carried)
detail: Crate spawn in the side cave east of the flooded tracks.

label: Open the water valve and take the lift down
detail: Around the large pipe near the flooded tracks: use the zealot's key on the valve to start the water flow, then run back and take the lift before a mischievous ghost shuts it off (retry the valve if the ghost wins).

label: Reach the crane-and-cart boss chamber
detail: From the flooded chamber (lit by the fungus), follow the east track past possessed pickaxes, down the stairs, into the loading-crane chamber. Do not take the innocent-looking key until ready for the fight.

label: Fight the ghost of Treus Dayth
detail: Taking the innocent-looking key summons the level-95 ghost. He teleports invisible between attacks (yellow minimap arrow marks his location) using mine carts (up to 9 dmg/tick on cart tracks -- run across instead of standing), possessed cranes (up to 10 dmg adjacent), thrown pickaxes (up to 15, Protect Missiles only reduces ~33%), and rare melee. Magic is recommended (weak to Wind/Crumble Undead); retreat through the east door any time to heal safely -- his HP doesn't reset.

hints.note: Boss keeps its current HP if you retreat and return.

label: Cut a salve shard from the crystal outcrop
detail: Climb back to level 5, take the second staircase down; the crystal-mine key opens the crystal room. Use a chisel on a crystal outcrop (Crafting 35) -- cut a couple extra as backup. Quest completes on returning to the surface.

label: Talk to Dimintheis (start Family Crest)
detail: Fenced house above the clothes shop, south-eastern Varrock. Agree to help; his three sons split the family crest into pieces decades ago and scattered; his son Caleb now cooks in Catherby.

label: Travel to Catherby
Ask Caleb for his crest piece
detail: Inside or near the sink building south of the Farming shop. Confirm his identity, ask what happened to the crest (mandatory to unlock the other pieces), then agree to bring fish-salad ingredients.

label: Gather 5 cooked fish for Caleb
detail: One each of cooked shrimp, salmon, tuna, bass, and swordfish. Ironman note (named non-GE vendors, no substitution needed for a normal account): raw fish from Frankie's Fishing Emporium (Port Piscarilius), cooked salmon from the West Ardougne General Store, cooked swordfish from the Shrimp and Parrot in Brimhaven (also a Tribal Totem reward), cooked bass from the Warrior Guild Food Shop.

label: Deliver the fish to Caleb for his crest piece
detail: He hands over his crest piece and mentions brother Avan was last seen searching the desert for treasure.

label: Ask the Al Kharid gem trader about Avan
detail: North Al Kharid, by the gnome glider. He recalls Avan searching for 'perfect gold' in the sand dunes.

label: Find Avan at the Al Kharid mine
detail: Wandering the northern Al Kharid mine pit entrance, wearing a yellow cape. He wants a ring and necklace of 'perfect gold' to win a lady's affection and mentions a dwarf named Boot who may know a source.

label: Ask Boot about perfect gold
detail: Down the trapdoor behind the eastern building of the Dwarven Mine (west of Edgeville Monastery); Boot wanders south-west of the entrance by the rock columns. He points to the Witchaven Dungeon east of Ardougne. Must be spoken to before Avan will accept the finished jewellery, even though it can technically be mined/smithed beforehand.

label: Solve the Witchaven Dungeon lever puzzle
detail: Enter and head north-east past hobgoblin/ogre rooms (Protect from Melee negates all their damage; no kills required). Six-step sequence to permanently unlock the hellhound room: north-room outer lever up; south room via east door, inner lever up, exit west door; north room outer lever down then inner lever up; north room outer lever up again; south room via west door, lever down, exit east door.

label: Mine 2 perfect gold ore
detail: In the unlocked hellhound room, mine the gold rocks (Mining 40) while zigzagging the level-122 hellhounds' short aggro range; a safespot exists behind the rock column south of the entrance if aggro is drawn (world-hop to reset a mined rock).

label: Smelt and smith the perfect ring and necklace
detail: At any furnace (Al Kharid is convenient for the Avan hand-off): smelt the 2 perfect gold ore into bars (Smithing 40), then use the ring mould and necklace mould with 2 cut rubies to smith a perfect ring and perfect necklace (Crafting 40) -- do not pick the plain gold jewellery menu options.

label: Give Avan the jewellery for his crest piece
detail: He hands over his crest piece and directs you to Johnathon at the Jolly Boar Inn north-east of Varrock.

label: Cure Johnathon with an antipoison potion
detail: 1F of the Jolly Boar Inn, north-west room. He's delirious from a poisonous spider bite -- use any antipoison potion on him (fully consumed regardless of dose).

label: Weaken and kill Chronozon for the last crest piece
detail: Johnathon lost the crest fighting Chronozon (level 170) in the Wilderness section of Edgeville Dungeon, by the poison spiders near the Earth obelisk. Cast Wind, Water, Earth, and Fire Blast, landing one confirmed hit each ('Chronozon weakens...' in chat), in any order, then finish with any style. A safespot exists one tile in front of the eastern standing torch.

hints.note: This is a Wilderness fight -- other players can attack you.

label: Reassemble the crest and return it to Dimintheis
detail: Combine the three crest pieces, return to Varrock, and hand the crest to Dimintheis. Quest complete -- pick one of Caleb's/Avan's/Johnathon's gauntlet imbuements.

label: Talk to Veliaf Hurtz (start In Aid of the Myreque)
detail: Myreque Hideout below Canifis (fairy ring dls, or the Canifis trapdoor + secret passage). He asks you to help establish a new base at Burgh de Rott now that the Hollows hideout is compromised.

refs.title: In Aid of the Myreque/Quick guide

label: Travel to Burgh de Rott
detail: South of Mort'ton. Carry 1 food item, hammer, pickaxe, spade, 1-5 buckets, 6 planks, and 44 nails -- there is no functioning bank here until it's repaired later.

refs.title: In Aid of the Myreque/Quick guide

label: Prove goodwill to Florin and enter Burgh de Rott
detail: Florin refuses entry, suspecting you're collecting food/blood for the vampyres. Use a food item on the open chest directly in front of the gate; he lets you in and the shades stop attacking. Ask about out-of-the-way places -- he suggests the inn cellar.

refs.title: In Aid of the Myreque/Quick guide

label: Clear the pub cellar rubble
detail: Climb over the broken wall into the inn (south-east of the gate), mine the trapdoor rubble, descend, then mine and spade every rubble pile into your buckets (3 loads/bucket) and empty them on the pile south-west outside the bar until the cellar is fully cleared. A cutscene reveals a wall plaque once done; leftover items dropped in the cellar vanish on exit.

hints.note: Bonus nails/rock/glass/scroll/fragment surface passively every few piles -- not quest-critical.

refs.title: In Aid of the Myreque/Quick guide

label: Offer to help Razvan and Aurel fix the town
detail: Talk to Razvan (usually just north of the bar) about helping, then to Aurel in the General Store (north-east) -- he asks for the roof and wall repaired.

refs.title: In Aid of the Myreque/Quick guide

label: Repair the General Store roof and wall
detail: Climb the ladder on the store's outside south wall; use 3 planks + 12 nails on the roof hole. Climb down and use 3 planks + 12 nails on the damaged wall east of the ladder.

refs.title: In Aid of the Myreque/Quick guide

label: Fill Aurel's stock crate
detail: Aurel always needs 10 bronze axes + 3 tinderboxes, plus either 10 mackerel OR 10 snail meat (randomly assigned per player -- reroll by exiting his dialogue before the crate handoff). Fill the crate with unnoted items and hand it back. While banking, also grab 5 planks, a hammer, swamp paste, and 20 nails for the next repair.

hints.note: Randomised per player; reroll available before accepting the crate.

refs.title: In Aid of the Myreque/Quick guide

label: Repair the bank and recruit Cornelius as banker
detail: South of the city. Inspect the bank booth, then the west wall, using 5 planks + 20 nails + swamp paste + a hammer. Talk to Cornelius, who agrees to become the banker.

refs.title: In Aid of the Myreque/Quick guide

label: Repair the furnace and fight Gadderanks' juvinates
detail: South-east corner. Repair the furnace with 2 steel bars + a hammer, add coal, light with a tinderbox -- a cutscene reveals Vanstrom's tithe collector Gadderanks demanding blood. Equip a silver weapon or Efaritay's aid; in the General Store, fight two level-54 Vampyre Juvinates (flinchable/safespottable behind the table) then Gadderanks himself (Veliaf assists).

refs.title: In Aid of the Myreque/Quick guide

label: Talk to the fallen Gadderanks, then Veliaf
detail: Gadderanks shares vampyre lore before succumbing; Veliaf asks you to return to the Hollows hideout to plan the move.

refs.title: In Aid of the Myreque/Quick guide

label: Return to the Myreque Hideout
detail: Bank any pets first (barred from the next instance). Veliaf asks you to escort Ivan Strom to Paterdomus Temple and ask Drezel about Ivandis's weapon.

refs.title: In Aid of the Myreque/Quick guide

label: Arm and feed Ivan before the escort
detail: Strongly recommended for lower-combat accounts: use a spare steel med helm, steel chainbody, steel platelegs, silver sickle, and up to 15 food items (stew/salmon/snails/slimy eel) on Ivan. None of these are returned afterward.

refs.title: In Aid of the Myreque/Quick guide

label: Escort Ivan through the swamp instance
detail: Talk to Radigad or Polmafi to signal departure, then Ivan to begin. Choose Route 1 (short: 2x level-75 Vampyre Juvinates) over Route 2 (long: 4x level-50s) -- easier to protect Ivan against fewer enemies. Keep Ivan behind you and tank the juvinate directly ahead; if he flees on low food/health, leave and retry with fresh food (he keeps any gear already given).

refs.title: In Aid of the Myreque/Quick guide

label: Press Drezel and read The sleeping seven
detail: West trapdoor at the escort's end. Press Drezel about Ivandis's weapon until he relents and gives a library key; use it on the keyholed wall east, descend, search the middle bookcase for 'The sleeping seven' and read it.

refs.title: In Aid of the Myreque/Quick guide

label: Make a rod mould from the coffin
detail: East of the Myreque hideout tunnel, use a hammer on the boarded 'X' entrance, enter, and use soft clay on the coffin inside.

refs.title: In Aid of the Myreque/Quick guide

label: Craft and enchant the Silvthrill rod
detail: At any furnace, use a silver bar + mithril bar + cut sapphire with the rod mould to craft a Silvthrill rod, then cast Lvl-1 Enchant on it (normal spellbook required; 1 cosmic + 1 water rune).

refs.title: In Aid of the Myreque/Quick guide

label: Charge the Rod of Ivandis at the Paterdomus well
detail: Take the enchanted rod and a rope to the Paterdomus Temple basement; use the rod on the well beside Drezel's room.

refs.title: In Aid of the Myreque/Quick guide

label: Deliver the Rod of Ivandis to Veliaf
detail: Burgh de Rott inn cellar. Quest complete.

refs.title: In Aid of the Myreque/Quick guide

label: Talk to Father Reen (start Shadow of the Storm)
detail: South of Al Kharid bank. He gives a free uncoloured Silverlight if you don't already carry a regular one -- bank any spare dyed Silverlight first, since carrying both later blocks progress.

label: Travel to the Ruins of Uzer
detail: Shantay Pass + magic carpet, a necklace of passage to Eagles' Eyrie then south-east, or fairy ring dlq then north-east. Bring Silverlight -- it's needed to continue.

label: Talk to Father Badden and pick a black mushroom
detail: Ask through all of his dialogue options. Pick a black mushroom outside the dungeon if not already carried, then enter.

label: Dye Silverlight and 3 clothing items black
detail: Grind the black mushroom into black dye with a pestle & mortar + vial. Assemble any 3 quest-accepted black clothing items (own-words per the page's own list -- e.g. a dyed desert shirt + robe, a black priest gown, dark mystic robes, black dragonhide, or 3 black cosmetic slot items; several black-looking cosmetic items like the black mask do NOT count, per the page's own exclusion list). Also dye Silverlight itself black with the same dye -- never carry a normal and a dyed Silverlight together.

label: Convince Evil Dave to let you through the portal
detail: Wearing all 3 black clothing items, tell Evil Dave you want to join the group. He leads you to Denath, the group's leader, who explains the plan to summon Agrith-Naar and gives a player-specific incantation order to remember (also written, reversed, in a demonic tome found later).

hints.note: Randomised per player; the demonic tome carries the reverse order as a backup.

label: Cut gems from the demon's throne (optional)
detail: Use a chisel and hammer on the demon's throne for 2 sapphires, 2 rubies, 2 emeralds -- skip if already done during The Golem.

label: Get the sigil mould and the clay golem's account
detail: Talk to Jennifer for a demonic sigil mould, then Matthew about Josef -- he asks you to find Josef's dropped book. Talk to the clay golem: it reveals Denath killed Josef and hid the book in an outdoor kiln (must ask the golem before the kilns become searchable).

label: Search the outdoor kilns for the Demonic Tome
detail: Four kilns around Uzer (near the magic carpet and east of the temple) -- search until the tome turns up.

label: Craft the demonic sigil
detail: At any furnace (fairy ring dkr to Edgeville is fastest), use the silver bar with the demonic sigil mould.

label: Chant the incantation in Denath's order
detail: Read the Demonic Tome (its incantation is the reverse of Denath's), return through the portal, and hand Matthew the book. Join Denath's circle and chant the incantation in the order Denath gave using your sigil -- Denath walks into the portal and vanishes: he WAS Agrith-Naar, and the 'backwards' order banished rather than summoned him.

label: Recruit five allies and their sigils
detail: Pick up Denath's dropped sigil (or immediately chase Tanya back through the portal for a double sigil/bones drop). Chase Evil Dave, Eric, and Tanya through the portal -- Tanya and Eric die to hazards (loot their sigils), then convince Evil Dave to return and hand over his. Recruit Father Badden and Father Reen (give each a spare sigil) and the clay golem (use the strange implement found in the lair on it first, then ask again) as the final participants.

hints.note: Optional trick, not required to progress.

label: Summon and kill Agrith-Naar with Silverlight
detail: Re-enter the portal, talk to Matthew to gather everyone, chant the incantation in the book's (opposite) order. Agrith-Naar (level 100) appears, kills Matthew, then attacks you -- melee by default, switches to Fire Blast if you pray/step out of range, or Telekinetic Grabs you back in if you pray Magic from range. No cannon allowed. The final blow MUST land with Silverlight or his HP snaps back to 12; Silverlight merges into Darklight automatically on the kill.

hints.note: Ducking behind a pillar/torch right before the kill registers voids the final hit.

label: Talk to the Dwarven Boatman to travel to Keldagrim
detail: Take fairy ring code DKS then head through the tunnel south-west and the Cave Entrance, or simply speak to the boatman to begin the trip.

hints.value: 1Yes, I'm ready and don't mind it taking a few minutes.

label: Finish the conversation with Commander Veldaban
detail: Commander Veldaban, near the West Keldagrim bank, briefs you on the sculptor's project.

label: Talk to Blasidar the sculptor
detail: Blasidar, on the east side of Keldagrim south of the kebab shop, explains he needs items for a statue of King Alvis.

label: Ask Vermundi about the exquisite clothes
detail: Vermundi the silk trader works the large eastern-market building in East Keldagrim.

hints.value: 2Yes, I'm looking for some special clothes.

label: Ask the Librarian about Dwarven costumes
detail: The Librarian sits in the library at the north-east corner of West Keldagrim.

hints.value: 2Do you know anything about King Alvis' clothes?

label: Climb a bookcase for the costume book
detail: Climbing any library bookcase yields the Scholars Guide to Dwarven Costumes; carrying 30kg or more of gear blocks the climb.

label: Source coal for the spinning machine
detail: Coal can be mined in the north-east corner of East Keldagrim, or bought from Ordan at the Blast Furnace if not already carried.

label: Tell Vermundi you're ready for the clothes
detail: Return to Vermundi once coal and logs are in hand.

label: Spin coal and logs into cloth
detail: Use coal and logs on the spinning machine next to Vermundi, then light the result with a tinderbox.

label: Buy the exquisite clothes from Vermundi for 200gp
detail: Pay Vermundi 200gp once the spun cloth is ready.

label: Buy 3 sapphires from Hervi if not already carried
detail: Hervi runs the gem stall just north of Vermundi.

label: Ask Saro about the special boots
detail: Saro works the anvil south-west of the West Keldagrim bank.

hints.value: 2Yes, I'm looking for a pair of special boots.

label: Speak to Dromund
detail: Dromund lives in a house just north of the West Keldagrim bank.

label: Take the left boot while Dromund isn't looking
detail: Slip the left boot away from Dromund's house while he's distracted.

label: Telegrab the right boot through the window
detail: Go outside behind Dromund's house and cast Telekinetic Grab on the right boot through the window while he isn't looking.

label: Ask Santiri about the battleaxe
detail: Santiri runs the weapon shop in north-western West Keldagrim and hands over the ancient dwarven battleaxe.

hints.value: 2Yes, I'm looking for a particular battleaxe.
2Blasidar the sculptor needs it for his statue.

label: Socket the 3 sapphires into the battleaxe
detail: Use the 3 sapphires on the ancient battleaxe now in your inventory.

label: Talk to Santiri again to confirm the axe
detail: Confirm the gem-set axe with Santiri before moving on.

hints.value: 2Yes, I'm looking for a particular battleaxe.

label: Ask the Librarian about the Imcando dwarves if needed
detail: Skip this and the next step entirely if Thurgo was already met via The Knight's Sword.

label: Ask Reldo about the Imcando dwarves if needed
detail: Reldo, in the Varrock Palace library, points toward Thurgo; skip if Thurgo has already been met.

label: Get Thurgo to repair the battleaxe
detail: Thurgo works at Mudskipper Point (fairy ring AIQ); give him an iron bar to repair the axe, with a redberry pie as a possible extra if he hasn't received one recently, then take the option to return to Keldagrim immediately.

hints.value: 3Can you help me with this ancient axe?

label: Give Riki the clothes, boots and axe
detail: Riki, Blasidar's model, receives the exquisite clothes, both boots, and the repaired battleaxe.

label: Talk to Blasidar and watch the statue cutscene
detail: Blasidar completes the statue once Riki has the items.

label: Choose a company and offer to help its secretary
detail: Pick any company except the Red Axe from the market's upper floor; progress only counts toward the one company chosen.

hints.value: 3Is there anything I can help you with?

label: Deliver requested ores until the hidden score allows bar tasks
detail: Each successful ore delivery (5 of a kind is a safe buffer, ores can be noted) gives 20 hidden points, refusals cost 2; ores can also be bought from Ordan at the Blast Furnace. Repeat until 75+ points unlocks director bar tasks.

label: Deliver bars for the director until membership is offered
detail: Bring unnoted metal bars requested by the director (12 points each); unlike the secretary, click the director again before advancing the dialogue. Continue until 100 points is reached.

hints.value: 3Do you have any more tasks for me?

label: Officially join the chosen company
detail: Accept membership when the director offers it, mentioning Blasidar sent you.

hints.value: 2I'd like to officially join your company.

label: Report to Commander Veldaban to finish
detail: Talk to Commander Veldaban west of the bank; you may decline the meeting invite offered afterward.

label: Talk to Dondakan (start Between a Rock...)
detail: Keldagrim SW mine, across the Dwarven Ferryman's river (2 coins or free with ring of charos(a)). Ask why he's firing a cannon at the wall, then ask again -- he wants information about the rock and sends the player to the Librarian.

label: Talk to the Engineer (Keldagrim palace anvil room)
detail: Western Trading Consortium, near the anvil (not the anvil itself, the room housing it). Sends the player to Rolad at the Dwarven Mine camp near Ice Mountain.

label: Talk to Rolad
detail: Eastern house, Dwarven Mine entrance camp. Asks the player to find 3 pages from a book about the rock.

label: Kill scorpions for page 1
detail: South-eastern Dwarven Mine.

hints.note: May take several kills; try switching worlds if unlucky.

label: Search the mine carts for page 2
detail: Along the mine's cart tracks.

label: Mine an ore rock for page 3
detail: Clay, copper, tin, or iron rocks inside the mine.

label: Talk to Rolad (deliver the pages, lie to keep the book)
detail: Give all 3 pages for the Dwarven lore book; when asked to return it, choose the lying dialogue option and keep it.

label: Buy an ammo mould from Nulodion
detail: Western house next to Rolad's, Dwarven Mine camp.

label: Talk to Dondakan (show a gold bar)
detail: Use a gold bar (or a gold ore, from the vein south of Dondakan's) on him -- he wants a golden cannonball made from it.

label: Smith a golden cannonball
detail: Any furnace (Falador, Edgeville, Zanaris after Lost City, Rellekka after Fremennik Trials) with the gold bar and the cannonball mould.

label: Talk to Dondakan (give the golden cannonball)
detail: He fires it through the wall, then wants to fire the player through too -- needs cannon-firing schematics and a gold helmet (Smithing 50) for safety.

label: Smith a gold helmet
detail: Any anvil, 3 gold bars.

label: Get the second schematic from the Engineer
detail: Western Keldagrim palace anvil room.

label: Read the last page of the Dwarven lore book
detail: Reveals the third schematic.

label: Talk to Khorvak (fourth schematic)
detail: White Wolf Tunnel bar, via Camelot Teleport or Burthorpe Games Room. Give him a dwarven stout from the table, or refuse -- either way he provides the final schematic.

label: Assemble all four schematics
detail: Move/rotate each of the 3 gathered pieces to fit the original schematic Dondakan gave.

label: Talk to Dondakan (assembled schematic)
detail: Return with the completed design.

label: Mine gold ore before entering the rock
detail: 6 minimum, 15 recommended (lowers the boss's combat level from 125 to 75). Must remain in the inventory -- equip the gold helmet first or any gold already carried disappears.

label: Fight the Arzinian Being of Bordanzan
detail: Equip the gold helmet, ask Dondakan to fire the player in, then talk to the second set of flames at the centre. 8-minute timer to mine gold AND defeat it; form (Magic/Ranged/Strength) depends on the player's highest combat stat.

hints.note: Removing the gold helmet at any point teleports the player back out to Dondakan -- an emergency escape.

label: Talk to Dondakan (quest complete)
detail: Quest complete.

label: Talk to Lazim (start Enakhra's Lament)
detail: South of the Bandit Camp, west of the Ancient Pyramid (free ferry via Ruins of Unkah + Shantay Pass, or Pharaoh's Sceptre to Jaldraocht). Agree to help build his statue -- asked for 32kg of sandstone.

label: Mine 32kg of sandstone and deliver it
detail: Nearby quarry; sandstone comes in 1/2/5/10kg blocks (chisel bigger blocks smaller as needed). Give pieces to Lazim one at a time until 32kg total.

label: Chisel the 32kg block into a statue base
detail: Chisel the fused 32kg block, then place it on the ground next to Lazim.

label: Mine 20kg more sandstone and deliver it
detail: Same quarry.

label: Chisel the 20kg block into a statue body
detail: Chisel and attach to the base.

label: Mine granite and chisel a statue head
detail: Mine two 5kg granite pieces (one for the head now, one spare for later) plus clay and coal while at the quarry. Chisel one 5kg piece into the chosen head (own head refused; choose Lazim, camel, or a god's head).

label: Place the head on the statue
detail: The statue falls through the ground into a hidden temple below -- Lazim pushes the player down after it.

label: Talk to Lazim (in the temple)
detail: He admits this was the plan all along and offers a treasure share -- explains the temple's doors need stone limbs, not keys.

label: Chisel/mine the 4 stone limbs off the fallen statue
detail: Left/right arm, left/right leg -- each opens one outer door.

label: Open the 4 outer doors and collect the Z/R/K sigils
detail: Travel anticlockwise so the 4 cutscenes play in order (own-words: Enakhra completing the temple for Zamorak; Avarrockian knights slain trying to stop her; Akthanakos failing to turn her from Zamorak; Enakhra animating a weak skeleton weapon for Zamorak). Each big room has a sigil (Z/R/K, plus the starting room's M).

label: Use a sigil to unlock the central door
detail: Climb the ladder up; a magic barrier blocks progress next to a recessed pedestal.

label: Make a camel-head mould and matching granite head
detail: Soft clay (from mined clay + water) on the recess pedestal makes a positive mould; chisel the spare 5kg granite to match.

label: Place the granite camel head into the pedestal
detail: Cutscene: Akthanakos is revealed standing confused by the pedestal before Enakhra freezes him.

label: Clear the Smoke room's furnace
detail: North-east corridor; cast a Wind Bolt or stronger to clear the blocked grate.

label: Light the Shadow room's braziers
detail: South-east corridor; light a candle before entering to avoid darkness damage. Own-words: guess-and-check which of logs/oak logs/willow logs/maple logs/a candle/coal lights each of the 6 braziers (Firemaking 45 only reveals the answer, it isn't required to light them).

label: Talk to Pentyn (Blood room) and give him food
detail: North-west corridor; the frozen knight is starving. Give a full (not half-eaten) bread/pie/cake/pizza/baked potato -- right-click use it on him. He shares advice on the other 3 rooms.

label: Thaw the Ice room's fountain
detail: South-west corridor; cast a Fire Bolt or stronger.

label: Cast Crumble Undead on the first Boneguard
detail: North of the barrier ladder. The spell must land; it collapses and a freed spirit asks the player to bury 5 big bones.

label: Talk to the second Boneguard with Protect from Melee active
detail: It attacks a couple of times then relents -- reveals it was enslaved by Enakhra and asks for help finishing a wall to block her line of sight, for 3 loads of sandstone.

label: Repair the Boneguard's wall (3 loads)
detail: Take sandstone from the nearby rubble pile, use on the wall, then chisel to trim; repeat 3 times.

label: Talk to the freed Boneguard (reveals Akthanakos)
detail: It crumbles and reveals itself as the Mahjarrat Akthanakos, freed after millennia -- gives the Camulet. Cutscene: Enakhra destroys the wall and both flee north as skeletons -- quest complete.

label: Travel to Entrana (trip 1: papyrus, wool, potatoes, dyes, silk)
detail: Via Port Sarim boat; Entrana bans weapons/armour. Carry only papyrus, candle, ball of wool, sack of potatoes, dyes, silk, empty sacks for this leg.

label: Talk to Auguste (start Enlightened Journey)
detail: West Entrana, north of the Herblore shop. Agree to help test his balloon transport system.

label: Make an origami balloon
detail: Use papyrus on the ball of wool for a balloon structure, then the unlit candle on it -- do not light it, or the items must be regathered.

label: Talk to Auguste (first test launch)
detail: Cutscene: the origami balloon launches.

label: Talk to Auguste again (second launch)
detail: He takes the remaining papyrus and sack of potatoes -- second cutscene (mob attacks the balloon). Receives a basket of apples and Auguste's willow sapling.

label: Make 8 sandbags
detail: Use empty sacks on the sand pit south of Auguste.

label: Talk to Auguste (hand over all trip-1 items)
detail: Give every remaining item; cycle all dialogue options so nothing is missed.

label: Plant Auguste's willow sapling
detail: Any tree patch; give the local farmer the basket of apples to protect it. Gather/produce alternative to the wiki's own 'buy 12 unnoted willow branches from the GE' shortcut -- grown from the quest's own sapling instead.

label: Cut 12 willow branches
detail: Secateurs on the grown tree; 6 branches per cut, with a wait between cuts for more to regrow.

label: Gather 10 regular logs
detail: Axes cannot be brought to Entrana -- cut/bank the logs beforehand.

label: Travel to Entrana (trip 2: branches, logs, tinderbox)
detail: Return with the willow branches, regular logs, and a tinderbox.

label: Use a willow branch on the balloon basket
detail: Triggers a cutscene; the log storage interface appears.

label: Talk to Auguste (flight tips)
detail: Explains the balloon control panel before the flight interface opens.

label: Fly the balloon through all three screens
detail: Own-words: sandbag drop = up 2, log = up 1, relax = right, rope = down 1, red rope = down 2. Avoid every obstacle (birds/trees/houses/clouds) across 3 screens and land one space above the marked pad without overshooting.

label: Talk to Auguste (landed, quest complete)
detail: Quest complete; unlocks the balloon transport system.

label: Talk to Commander Veldaban (start Forgettable Tale...)
detail: Dwarven Black Guard HQ, west of the Keldagrim bank. Agree to investigate the Red Axe's sudden departure -- auto-transported by cutscene to a drunk dwarf's house in east Keldagrim.

label: Buy a beer
detail: Laughing Miner Pub or King's Axe Inn, Keldagrim, 2 coins.

label: Talk to the drunk dwarf (give beer)
detail: He wants 'the REALLY good stuff' (Kelda stout) instead -- gives the first of 4 kelda seeds needed to grow it.

label: Talk to the Rowdy Dwarf (trade for a seed)
detail: Laughing Miner pub. He asks for one random item from a long list (e.g. cabbage, banana, ashes, broken glass, potato, king worm) in exchange for the second seed -- own-words: bring/gather/produce the requested item, re-ask if the current request is unobtainable.

hints.note: The requested item is randomised per player; wait and re-ask for a different request if the current one is impractical.

label: Talk to Khorvak (borrow/trade for a seed)
detail: White Wolf Mountain pub, reached via minecart. Convince him to lend the seed, or give him a dwarven stout from a nearby table -> third seed.

label: Talk to Gauss (toast for the last seed)
detail: King's Axe Inn, west Keldagrim. Toast with a full or empty beer glass -> fourth seed.

label: Plant the 4 kelda seeds
detail: Kelda hops patch in front of the West Keldagrim palace, east of the bank -- ask Rind the gardener for permission first, weed with the free rake. Kelda hops grow only underground and cannot be diseased.

label: Harvest the kelda hops
detail: Pick once grown (15-20 min).

label: Brew Kelda stout
detail: East Keldagrim fermenting vat (Port Phasmatys vat will NOT work). Add 2 buckets of water, 2 barley malt, the kelda hops, then ale yeast (or a free pot filled by Blandebir for 25gp). Ferments 15-20 min; turn the valve and use a beer glass on the barrel when ready.

label: Talk to the drunk dwarf (give Kelda stout)
detail: He drinks it and tells of a boarded-up tunnel (cutscene).

label: Talk to the mining company director
detail: Upstairs in either Keldagrim marketplace (the director from The Giant Dwarf). Ask for help with the boarded tunnel -- boards removed at once.

label: Ride the new tunnel cart and solve the track puzzles (Rooms 1-6)
detail: Southernmost cart, no ticket, empty hands required. Six connected rooms: Rooms 1/3/5 are cart-track junction puzzles (place green/yellow direction stones, ride to search a box, return); Room 2 is an eavesdropped cutscene revealing the Red Axe's bribery plot; Room 4 is an archive -- search all 3 crates and a bookcase for lore letters; Room 6 shows the Red Axe's Chaos Dwarf army before Grunsh the ogre shaman wipes the player's memory of the caves.

label: Talk to Commander Veldaban (memory wiped)
detail: No memory remains of the tunnel, but instinct pulls the player toward beer and a kebab in east Keldagrim.

label: Buy a kebab and a beer
detail: East Keldagrim: kebab from the store south-west of the drunk dwarf's house (1gp), beer from the pub (1-2gp). Do not consume before talking to Veldaban.

label: Eat the kebab and drink the beer at the east pub
detail: Triggers the final cutscene: the player tells a nonsensical drunken story -- quest complete.

label: Talk to Queen Ellamaria (start Garden of Tranquillity)
detail: Fenced garden east of Varrock Palace. She hands over her wanted-plants list and sends the player to the Wise Old Man about diplomacy first.

label: Talk to the Wise Old Man (diplomacy quiz)
detail: Draynor Village, ring of charos in hand. Answer 6 required diplomacy prompts correctly (own-words: choosing compromise, generosity, enthusiasm for farming, humility, flattery, and patience over confrontation) -- the 7th accepts any answer. He enchants the ring.

label: Talk to Elstan (agree to grow marigolds)
detail: Farming patch south of Falador, ring of charos(a) worn. Ask about delphinium seeds; accept growing marigolds WITHOUT using the charm dialogue option (using charm gets refused first).

label: Plant the marigold seed
detail: Compost, water, plant cure as normal; ~20 minutes to grow.

label: Harvest and deliver the marigolds
detail: Give the harvested marigolds to Elstan.

label: Talk to Lyra (agree to grow onions)
detail: Allotment patch west of Port Phasmatys, ring of charos(a) worn. Ask about orchid seeds; accept growing onions WITHOUT charm.

label: Plant 3 onion seeds
detail: Flower patch must be empty first; ~40 minutes to grow.

label: Talk to Lyra (deliver the onions)
detail: Rewards 3 yellow + 3 pink orchid seeds.

label: Talk to Kragen (agree to grow cabbages)
detail: Allotment patch north of East Ardougne, ring of charos(a) worn. Ask about snowdrop seeds; accept growing cabbages WITHOUT charm.

label: Plant 3 cabbage seeds
detail: Flower patch must be empty first; ~40 minutes to grow.

label: Talk to Kragen (deliver the cabbages)
detail: Rewards 4 snowdrop seeds.

label: Talk to Dantaera (charm for the white tree)
detail: Catherby farming patch. Ask how to grow a White Tree, charm her -- she permits cutting a branch from the white tree atop Ice Mountain.

label: Cut and grow a white tree sapling
detail: Ice Mountain, west of Edgeville, near the Oracle. Secateurs on the white tree for a shoot; use it on a filled plant pot with the gardening trowel, then water it. Grows to a sapling in ~5 minutes.

label: Talk to Brother Althric (charm; told to discard the ring)
detail: Edgeville Monastery garden, ring of charos(a) worn. Charm him about the rosebushes -- he calls the ring an 'evil talisman' and demands it be thrown in the Edgeville well or destroyed.

label: Discard the ring of charos(a) as instructed
detail: Throw the ring into the Edgeville well (recoverable by fishing) or destroy it outright (recoverable by re-pickpocketing Dr Fenkenstrain).

label: Recover the ring of charos(a)
detail: If thrown in the well: fish it out with a fishing/fly fishing rod (several tries may be needed). If destroyed: pickpocket Dr Fenkenstrain again.

hints.note: Fishing the ring from the well can take several attempts.

label: Talk to Brother Althric again (no ring)
detail: Attempt to take the seeds again without the ring equipped -- he's now satisfied. Rewards all three rose seed colours.

label: Talk to Bernald (charm; treat the dying vines)
detail: The Toad and Chicken pub garden, Burthorpe, ring of charos(a) worn. Charm him about his dying vines; use one plant cure on them -- it doesn't work. Told to find Alain in Taverley.

label: Talk to Alain (learn to strengthen the cure)
detail: Taverley tree patch, near the members' gate. Do NOT use the charm dialogue option, or he refuses to help.

label: Make a strengthened plant cure
detail: Hammer a rune/pure essence into rune shards, then pestle and mortar into rune dust; use the dust on the remaining plant cure.

label: Talk to Bernald (cure the vines)
detail: Use the strengthened cure on the vines -- cured. Rewards Burthorpe vine seeds.

label: Talk to Queen Ellamaria (get the statue trolley)
detail: Ask about getting the statues -- she provides a trolley.

label: Push/pull the king's statue from Lumbridge to the garden
detail: Lumbridge Castle south exit; identify the 'king' statue, push/pull it across the bridge, then east and south into Ellamaria's garden; place on the north-east (east side) plinth.

hints.note: If the statue takes over 5 minutes to place it gets 'recaptured' and must be fetched again.

label: Push/pull the Saradomin statue from Falador to the garden
detail: Falador city square (not the park statue); a cutscene plays before the guards notice. Push/pull it out of Falador's north gate, then east and south into the garden; place on the central plinth.

hints.note: Guards discover the theft after 5 minutes; the statue must be re-fetched if so.

label: Plant every seed/sapling in Ellamaria's garden
detail: Rake the weeds first; no compost/watering needed except on the orchid pots (compost required there). Plant delphinium, orchids (both colours), snowdrop, all 3 rose colours, Burthorpe vine seed, and the white tree sapling; ~10-15 minutes to grow.

label: Fetch King Roald and give the garden tour
detail: South-east ground floor of Varrock Palace, ring of charos(a) worn. Charm him where possible; escort back without opening any interfaces or walking away -- cutscene tour, then the queen rewards the player.

label: Gather bones + buckets/pots for the Ectofuntus
detail: Kill level-1 undead chickens near the farm west of the Ectofuntus for bones; buy/carry 7 empty buckets and 7 empty pots (Port Phasmatys, entering via charter ship from Port Sarim costs 1,300gp before tokens are gathered).

label: Fill buckets with slime and grind bones to bonemeal
detail: Down the trapdoor west of the Ectofuntus fountain; use a bucket on the Pool of Slime to auto-fill all carried buckets, then use a bone on the loader by the bone grinder (interacting with the grinder speeds up the automated cycle).

label: Worship the Ectofuntus for ecto-tokens
detail: Click the Ectofuntus to consume each slime+bonemeal set, then talk to a ghost disciple while wearing the ghostspeak amulet. ~35 recommended (20 with an activated ring of charos(a)).

label: Talk to Velorina (start Ghosts Ahoy)
detail: Pay 2 ecto-tokens at the Energy Barrier north of Port Phasmatys; she explains the ghosts' plight and sends the player to Necrovarus at the Ectofuntus temple.

label: Talk to Necrovarus (first attempt)
detail: He refuses to discuss releasing the ghosts.

label: Talk to Velorina again
detail: She recalls an old friend who might help without Necrovarus -- a small wooden shack in Morytania near the sea, between two castles.

label: Make nettle tea
detail: Fill a bowl with water at the waterpump west of the farm patches; pick nettles east of Slayer Master Mazchna (closed-fingered gloves required); use nettles on the water bowl, then light a fire and use the bowl on it.

label: Talk to the Old Crone (tea, then milk)
detail: North-west of Mazchna, between the Slayer Tower and the Mausoleum. She only drinks from her own cup (gives a porcelain cup to pour the tea into); refuses again until a bucket of milk is added. Once satisfied, she recalls Velorina and explains that enchanting the Ghostspeak amulet needs Necrovarus's magical robes, his book of rituals (Haricanto), and a translation manual. She also gives a model ship for her sailor son.

label: Repair the model ship
detail: Canifis bank/general store for silk, needle and thread (or costume needle), and a knife -- use them on the model ship.

label: Read the wrecked ship's flag colours
detail: Wrecked ship on the north coast of the farm patch; climb to the quarterdeck, wait for low wind, then search the mast up to 3 times to identify the tattered flag's colours (own-words: mixing red+yellow=orange, red+blue=purple, blue+yellow=green as needed) before dyeing the ship to match.

hints.note: Colours are randomised per player; check the mast at least 3 times.

label: Dye the model ship to match the flag
detail: Mix the needed dyes and paint the model ship's pieces.

label: Talk to the Old Man (give the model ship)
detail: He recognises it as his own -- gives a chest key.

label: Open the two accessible chests for map scraps
detail: Chest 1 (captain's quarters, use the key): first scrap. Cross the rock-jump path north-west of the deck (Agility 25, boostable, no fall risk into water) to a second chest: second scrap.

label: Kill the Giant lobster guarding the third chest
detail: Level 32, appears when searching the chests near the ladder; must be killed within two minutes or it resets.

hints.note: Safespottable with Magic or Ranged from west of the nearest ladder.

label: Search the chest for the third map scrap
detail: After the Giant lobster is dead.

label: Combine the three map scraps
detail: Use one scrap on another twice to assemble the full treasure map.

label: Sail to Dragontooth Island and dig up the book
detail: Ghost captain on the Port Phasmatys dock; pay 25 ecto-tokens (10 with an activated ring of charos(a), or 500 for permanent access). Follow the treasure map's step-count directions from the Statue of Saradomin and dig with a spade.

label: Get the translation manual from Ak-Haranu (via Robin)
detail: Ak-Haranu on the Port Phasmatys docks wants Robin's signature on an oak longbow in trade for the manual. Beat Robin at Rune-Draw at the nearby pub (draw runes for points, avoid drawing a death rune, until he owes 100 coins) for his signature, then return it to Ak-Haranu.

hints.note: Rune-Draw is a dice-style minigame vs Robin; repeat until he owes 100 coins.

label: Talk to the Ghost innkeeper (get a bedsheet)
detail: He wants a bedsheet delivered to Robin -- keep it instead, to disguise as a ghost.

label: Colour the bedsheet with Ectofuntus slime
detail: Buy a bucket of slime from a Trader crewmember on the east docks (or fill one at the Ectofuntus slime pool), then dip the bedsheet.

label: Gather 10 petition signatures in disguise
detail: Wear the dyed bedsheet; talk to Gravingas near the north entrance for a petition form, then ask nearby ghost villagers for signatures (don't ask the same one twice in a row; skip any who demand ecto-tokens).

hints.note: Cycle between 2-3 willing ghosts, or switch worlds, until 10 signatures are collected.

label: Talk to Necrovarus (show the petition)
detail: He rages at the petition and drops a bone key -- pick it up.

label: Unlock Necrovarus's room and take his robes
detail: Use the bone key on the locked upstairs door; open and search the coffin.

label: Talk to the Old Crone (enchant the amulet)
detail: Give the robes, Book of Haricanto, translation manual, and ghostspeak amulet -- she performs a dancing ritual to empower the amulet.

label: Talk to Necrovarus (command him to release the ghosts)
detail: With the empowered ghostspeak amulet equipped, command him to free the ghosts he's holding.

label: Talk to Velorina (quest complete)
detail: She senses the barrier's removal and hands over a vial of ectoplasm -- the Ectophial.

label: Talk to Gertrude (start Ratcatchers)
detail: West of Varrock. Directs the player to the Sisters Grime in Varrock Sewers.

label: Talk to the Sisters Grime (Phingspet + Grimesquit)
detail: East of the Palace exit, Varrock Sewers. They must sniff the cat before it starts counting caught rats -- then tasks the player with catching 8 rats.

label: Chase 8 rats in the Varrock Sewers
detail: Use the cat's 'Chase' option.

label: Talk to the Sisters Grime (turn in)
detail: Rewards a rat pole; directs the player to Jimmy Dazzler in East Ardougne.

label: Talk to Jimmy Dazzler
detail: House west of the Flying Horse Inn, East Ardougne. He needs a client's mansion cleared of rats unofficially -- gives Directions, then teleports the player to the mansion gardens.

label: Sneak through the mansion and catch 6 rats
detail: Own-words: three guard-patrol checkpoints must be crossed unseen (Run recommended, patience required -- being spotted resets to the last checkpoint, not the start). Catch 1 rat in the first upstairs room, 2 in the next, then the last 3 plus the kitchen once past the guards entirely.

hints.note: Guard patrol timing is scripted; wait for the correct guard position before each dash, per each room's own pattern.

label: Talk to Jimmy Dazzler (turn in)
detail: Rewards access to the Ardougne Rat Pits; directs the player to Hooknosed Jack in south-east Varrock.

label: Talk to Hooknosed Jack
detail: South-east Varrock. Warehouse rat infestation -- he can make rat poison from a vial, red spiders' eggs, and a kwuarm if not already carried.

label: Poison 4 cheese
detail: Use rat poison on 4 pieces of cheese.

label: Poison the warehouse's 4 rat holes
detail: Top of the warehouse south of the pub; use the poisoned cheese on each hole (don't eat it).

label: Talk to Hooknosed Jack (Pox got poisoned)
detail: His cat Pox ate a poisoned rat -- sends the player to the Apothecary for an antidote.

label: Make cat antipoison at the Apothecary
detail: West Varrock; give a marrentill herb, crushed unicorn horn, and a bucket of milk.

label: Talk to Hooknosed Jack (cure Pox)
detail: Give the antipoison -- Pox recovers; warns of the King rat.

label: Send the cat to fight the King rat
detail: Warehouse upstairs; 10 HP, max 1 damage per hit. Use the cat on the hole in the wall to start; heal with fish on the same hole (not the cat) as needed.

hints.note: Choose 'Be careful!' so the cat auto-retreats at 1 HP instead of risking death.

label: Talk to Hooknosed Jack (turn in)
detail: Rewards access to the Varrock Rat Pits; directs the player to Smokin' Joe in Keldagrim.

label: Talk to Smokin' Joe
detail: East Keldagrim, by the pickaxe shop. Agree to help smoke out his rats.

label: Smoke out Smokin' Joe's rat hole
detail: Light a pot of weeds with a tinderbox, use on the rat hole east of Smokin' Joe. Drop the cat on the ground, wear the catspeak amulet, then use the smouldering pot on the hole again -- the cat offers to ambush the rats; accept.

label: Talk to Smokin' Joe (turn in)
detail: Rewards access to the Keldagrim Rat Pits; directs the player to The Face in Port Sarim.

label: Talk to The Face
detail: Port Sarim, by the fishing shop. Directs the player down to Felkrash in the rat pits.

label: Talk to Felkrash (rat pits)
detail: Wants all of Port Sarim's vermin cleared at once.

label: Talk to The Face again (ask about the snake charmer)
detail: 3rd dialogue option; reveals a snake charmer in Pollnivneach.

label: Talk to Ali/Badir the Snake Charmer
detail: South of the bar, Pollnivneach. Use a coin on his money pot for attention; ask about charming other animals, offer money, then walk away until prompted to stop. Rewards a music scroll + snake charm for 100gp (50gp with ring of charos, and skips the walk-away step).

label: Play the charming tune at the Port Sarim docks
detail: Own-words: compose the notes shown on the music scroll in order, then play -- charms the vermin into following the player into the ocean (cutscene).

label: Talk to Felkrash (quest complete)
detail: Quest complete.

label: Talk to Awusah the Mayor (start Spirits of the Elid)
detail: Nardah. Learns of the town's curse and dried-up water supply.

label: Talk to Ghaslor the Elder (get the ballad)
detail: House just north of the mayor's. Do not bank or drop the ballad -- it's needed later.

label: Search the cupboards for torn robes
detail: Building housing Shiratti the Custodian, west of the mayor's house.

label: Repair the robes of Elidinis
detail: Needle and thread on both torn robe pieces.

label: Cast Telekinetic Grab on the ancestral key
detail: Steals it from its enclosed display area.

label: Travel to the River Elid waterfall and enter
detail: North-west of Nardah, following the river bank to its source (passes a bronze pickaxe/shortbow/bronze arrow respawn and a pluckable Desert Phoenix feather). Use a rope on the root above the waterfall to enter.

label: Open the temple door wearing the robes
detail: Robes of Elidinis worn, ballad and ancestral key carried.

label: Kill the Black golem (crush attacks)
detail: North-east room. Level 75; vulnerable to crush.

label: Clear the north-east water channel
detail: Attack the target across the channel with Ranged or Magic.

label: Kill the Grey golem (slash attacks)
detail: East room. Level 75; vulnerable to slash.

label: Clear the east water channel
detail: Use a pickaxe on the channel.

label: Kill the White golem (stab attacks)
detail: South room. Level 75; vulnerable to stab.

label: Clear the south water channel
detail: Requires Thieving 37 to clear.

label: Talk to the spirits Nirrie, Tirrie and Hallak
detail: Through the remaining north door, around the lake. Told to recover the Statue of Elidinis from a crevice west of Nardah.

label: Remove the soles from the mayor's shoes
detail: Nardah; knife on the shoes left by his door.

label: Travel to the crevice and enter
detail: West of the Nardah general store; rope on the crevice, light source required to avoid bug damage.

label: Talk to the genie (trade soles for the statue)
detail: Give the mayor's soles to receive the Statue of Elidinis.

label: Place the Statue of Elidinis on the shrine plinth
detail: Nardah shrine (same building the ancestral key was stolen from) -- quest complete.

label: Make a sapphire lantern (pre-quest)
detail: Add a cut sapphire to a bullseye lantern (unf), fill with lamp oil made from swamp tar (chemist's still, Rimmington, or the Dorgesh-Kaan lamp still), then light with a tinderbox. Bullseye lantern itself is gather/produce only per the quest's own list: Smithing 49, or pickpocket cave goblins at Thieving 36, or a Slayer 35 wall-beast kill -- never GE.

label: Enter the Lumbridge Swamp Caves
detail: Rope needed on first entry via the swamp entrance (dodge wall beasts by stopping one tile short of each hole, then running past; take the south path to avoid poison cave crawlers). Faster/safer via the Lumbridge cellar route if The Lost Tribe has been partially completed (pickaxe to clear rocks).

label: Talk to Juna (tell her stories)
detail: Chasm of Tears, deep in the caves. Tell her stories of the player's adventures -- she explains a stone bowl is needed to collect the tears, made from rock across the chasm, reached by attracting a light creature.

label: Attract a light creature across the chasm
detail: Climb the rocks back the way in; use 'attract' on a light creature with the lit sapphire lantern -- it carries the player across.

label: Mine a magic stone and chisel it into a bowl
detail: Pickaxe on the magic stone, then chisel into a stone bowl.

label: Talk to Juna (give the bowl)
detail: Climb down to Juna and hand over the stone bowl -- quest complete.

label: Talk to Lucien (start Temple of Ikov)
detail: Flying Horse Inn, north-western East Ardougne. Agree to retrieve the Staff of Armadyl from the Temple of Ikov -- given the Pendant of Lucien to enter the Chamber of Fear.

label: Enter the Temple of Ikov dungeon
detail: South of the Ranging Guild, west of the Sorcerer's Tower. Climb down the ladder.

label: Get the boots of lightness
detail: West to a set of stairs down (light source needed); slash the web, take and equip the boots -- the cheapest way to reach -1kg for the bridge.

label: Cross the unsteady bridge at -1kg or lighter
detail: Pendant of Lucien worn to pass the north gate. Drop any items needed to reach -1kg or lower (failing costs 20 damage) before crossing; take the lever on the far side.

label: Pull the lever to open the southern room
detail: Place the retrieved lever on the wall bracket south-west of the entrance, then pull it.

label: Gather ice arrows from the ice chamber chests
detail: 6 chests, only one holding arrows (1-5) at a time -- keep re-searching. Only 1 ice arrow is needed if using throwing weapons instead of a bow.

hints.note: Arrow spawn chest is reselected randomly after each loot, including in succession.

label: Search then pull the trapped lever
detail: Small alcove north of the ice chamber. Search for traps first (Thieving 42) or take 20 spike damage, then pull to unlock the western passage.

label: Defeat the Fire Warrior of Lesarkus
detail: Level 84; only takes damage from ice arrows (or a throwing weapon with at least 1 ice arrow equipped, which bypasses the Ranged 40 requirement). Uses only Magic -- Protect from Magic recommended.

label: Talk to Winelda (pay the lava crossing)
detail: Give all 20 unnoted limpwurt roots at once -- she teleports the player across the lava.

label: Push the brick wall to reveal the hidden room
detail: Past the skeletons -- opens into the room where the choice is made.

label: Side with the Guardians of Armadyl
detail: Unequip the Pendant of Lucien first. Tell them Lucien wants the staff for a reward, accept their cleansing, then agree to help defeat Lucien -- given the Armadyl pendant (must be worn to fight him).

label: Side with Lucien
detail: Take the Staff of Armadyl from the north-west table -- a level 43 Guardian attacks; defeat it and take the staff. (Killing rather than talking to the Guardians preserves the option to still obtain the Armadyl pendant later.)

label: Defeat Lucien (Guardians' side)
detail: His house between Edgeville and the Grand Exchange, Armadyl pendant equipped -- level 14 -- quest complete.

label: Give the staff to Lucien (Lucien's side)
detail: His house between Edgeville and the Grand Exchange -- quest complete.

label: Search the tent and camping equipment (start)
detail: Campsite south of the lizardman settlement, Kebos Lowlands (fairy ring BLS closest). Search the tent for Kasonde's journal (Old Ones lore) and the camping equipment for secateurs if not already carried, then climb down the hole.

label: Search the camp dungeon's tablets, carvings and vase
detail: Stone tables (1st stone tablet), two more stone tables (2 wood carvings), one vase (a dirty note hinting at translation), and the stone chest (phrase 'Miki Toka').

label: Translate the camp dungeon's words
detail: Own-words: input the discovered word-pairs for island/lake/time/vessel/garden/north per the carvings' illustrations -- directs the player north, under the island on Lake Molch.

label: Travel to Molch Island
detail: Fairy ring DJR then south-west to the east dock, boat across; or Kharedst's memoirs to Shayzien and run north-west.

label: Search the Molch Island dungeon's tablets, carvings and vase
detail: Climb down behind the hut; a dirty note on the vines hints Kasonde returned to camp. Cut the vines with secateurs; search tables (2nd stone tablet), one more table (3rd wood carving), the east vases (4th wood carving + phrase 'Tlane Kualt'), the chest (phrase 'Olkat'), and rubble by the farming patches (5th wood carving).

label: Translate the Molch Island words
detail: Own-words: input the 8 discovered word-pairs (west/poison/animal/body/food/earth/air/fire) -- directs the player west of the lake, to Xeric's Shrine.

label: Travel to Xeric's Shrine
detail: Board the boat back to Molch, then south-west to Xeric's Shrine.

label: Search Xeric's Shrine dungeon's tablets, carvings and compass
detail: Climb down at the shrine's east side. South-east stone table (3rd stone tablet), the adjacent open chest (a compass giving the cardinal-direction words), a north vase, two more stone tables, and the central mushroom (4 more wood carvings).

label: Translate Xeric's Shrine words
detail: Own-words: input the 7 discovered word-pairs (build/yes/no/move/arrive/east/south) -- directs the player to a structure south-east, in a forest: the Ruins of Morra.

label: Travel to the Ruins of Morra
detail: Boat to Shayzien then south-east past the Shayziens' Wall, or teleport to Shayzien via Kharedst's memoirs and run south.

label: Search the Ruins of Morra dungeon's final tablet and carvings
detail: Hole in front of the step pyramid. Southern stone table (final stone tablet), remaining tables/vase/chest/rubble for the last wood carvings and a warning note.

label: Translate the final words and read the warning
detail: Own-words: input the final 8 word-pairs (small/big/light/dark/life/death/knowledge/home). Read the completed tablet, then the warning note revealing Kasonde reached the same conclusion about the Old Ones and soul transference -- quest complete.

label: Talk to Bert (start The Hand in the Sand)
detail: Bert works the sandpit east of the Yanille POH portal; found a severed hand and is afraid to report it. Agree to help -> receive sandy hand.

refs.title: The Hand in the Sand/Quick guide

label: Buy a pint of beer
detail: Ye Olde Dragon Inn bartender, Yanille, 2 coins.

refs.title: The Hand in the Sand/Quick guide

label: Talk to the captain of the guards (give beer, hand)
detail: Ye Olde Dragon Inn; give the beer, he drops the sandy hand in it -> beer-soaked hand; suspects the wizards.

refs.title: The Hand in the Sand/Quick guide

label: Talk to Zavistic Rarve (Wizards' Guild)
detail: Ring the guild bell if under 66 Magic; show the hand -> identified as student wizard Clarence's; asks about Bert's recent working hours.

refs.title: The Hand in the Sand/Quick guide

label: Talk to Bert (ask about his schedule)
detail: He gives his copy of the sand-hauling rota (Sandy's Sand Corp, Brimhaven) -> compare against Sandy's original in Brimhaven (30 coins via Ardougne ferry, or teleport).

refs.title: The Hand in the Sand/Quick guide

label: Search Sandy's desk (Brimhaven office)
detail: Sandy's office, north-west of the Dead Man's Chest bar, Brimhaven; search the desk for his original rota to compare against Bert's copy.

refs.title: The Hand in the Sand/Quick guide

label: Pickpocket Sandy for sand
detail: Sandy's office, Brimhaven; keep the sand pinched from his pocket -- needed later as the personal item for the truth serum.

hints.note: May take multiple pickpocket attempts.

refs.title: The Hand in the Sand/Quick guide

label: Talk to Bert (hand over both rotas)
detail: Yanille; give Bert's and Sandy's rotas -- he doesn't remember the change, blames wizard magic leaking nearby -> exchanges a mind-altering magic scroll found in his house.

refs.title: The Hand in the Sand/Quick guide

label: Talk to Zavistic Rarve (give the magic scroll)
detail: Confirms it's a mind-altering scroll explaining Bert's forgetting; suspects Sandy -- tasks the player with getting a truth serum from Betty in Port Sarim and recording Sandy with a magical orb. Offers one free teleport to Betty's shop for an empty vial.

hints.note: Zavistic offers one free teleport to Betty's shop in exchange for an empty vial.

refs.title: The Hand in the Sand/Quick guide

label: Buy redberries (Food Store, Port Sarim)
detail: Port Sarim Food Store.

refs.title: The Hand in the Sand/Quick guide

label: Talk to Betty (about the quest)
detail: Betty's shop, Port Sarim; explain the quest -- she asks for another empty vial and gives bottled water in return.

refs.title: The Hand in the Sand/Quick guide

label: Make redberry juice
detail: Use redberries on the bottled water.

refs.title: The Hand in the Sand/Quick guide

label: Make pink dye
detail: Use white berries on the redberry juice. White berries are not sold by Betty; source per the quest's own alternative list (Farming 59 whiteberry seed, or a rare drop from cave crawlers / Yanille Agility Dungeon chaos druid warriors) -- gather/produce only, never GE.

refs.title: The Hand in the Sand/Quick guide

label: Make a rose-tinted lens
detail: Use pink dye on the lantern lens.

refs.title: The Hand in the Sand/Quick guide

label: Talk to Betty (focus the lens)
detail: Stand in the doorway while it's open; use the rose-tinted lens on the counter to focus light onto an empty vial while she pours the serum. The lens shatters; she says she still needs a personal item from Sandy.

refs.title: The Hand in the Sand/Quick guide

label: Talk to Betty (give Sandy's sand)
detail: Give the sand pickpocketed from Sandy earlier -- she finishes the truth serum and warns it must be diluted in tea or coffee.

refs.title: The Hand in the Sand/Quick guide

label: Buy 5 earth runes from Betty
detail: 20gp from Betty's shop, before leaving Port Sarim.

refs.title: The Hand in the Sand/Quick guide

label: Talk to Sandy (distract, dose his coffee)
detail: Sandy's office, Brimhaven; distract him with tall tales (try every dialogue option -- no single guaranteed one) until he looks out the window, then use the truth serum on his coffee. Activate the magical orb and talk to him again to record his confession.

hints.note: No single distraction option is guaranteed to work; cycle through them.

refs.title: The Hand in the Sand/Quick guide

label: Talk to Zavistic Rarve (show the recorded confession)
detail: Yanille; hand over the filled magical orb as proof of Sandy's confession. He asks for 5 earth runes and a bucket of sand to compensate Bert.

refs.title: The Hand in the Sand/Quick guide

label: Fill a bucket of sand at Bert's sandpit
detail: Bert's sandpit, Yanille.

refs.title: The Hand in the Sand/Quick guide

label: Talk to Zavistic Rarve (give runes + sand)
detail: Hand over the 5 earth runes and bucket of sand -- he casts a spell to permanently refill Bert's sandpit, then asks the player to check the Entranan sandpit for the rest of Clarence's remains.

refs.title: The Hand in the Sand/Quick guide

label: Deposit weapons/armour (Port Sarim bank deposit box)
detail: Entrana bans weapons and armour; use the deposit box at Port Sarim before crossing.

refs.title: The Hand in the Sand/Quick guide

label: Talk to Mazion (Entrana sandpit)
detail: Entrana; recovers the dead wizard's head.

refs.title: The Hand in the Sand/Quick guide

label: Talk to Zavistic Rarve (hand over the wizard's head)
detail: Yanille; confirms it's Clarence's head. Sandy is arrested and Zavistic rewards the player -- quest complete.

refs.title: The Hand in the Sand/Quick guide

label: Talk to Pirate Pete at the dock to start
detail: Pirate Pete waits at the dock north-east of the Ectofuntus; agree to help him, agree past his Barrelor warning, then refuse the money he offers before he knocks you out and rows you off.

label: Wake up and talk to Captain Braindeath
detail: A cutscene reveals Pete's story was fabricated; you wake in the rum brewery on Braindeath Island and Captain Braindeath explains the zombie-pirate siege and the rum plan.

label: Take the rake and seed dibber from the basement cupboard
detail: If not already held, go down the north-west ladder to the basement and head south-east past the spiders to a cupboard.

label: Intimidate zombie swabs blocking the farming patches
detail: Leave via the southernmost stairway; if attacked by zombie swabs, walk out of combat and right-click Intimidate to permanently stop them attacking.

label: Rake and plant the blindweed seed
detail: Use the rake on the only usable (south-eastern) patch to clear weeds, then plant Braindeath's seed with the dibber.

label: Harvest the grown blindweed
detail: Wait for the "I wonder how my blindweed is coming along..." notification, then harvest. If lost afterward, Braindeath supplies a backup.

label: Add blindweed to the hopper upstairs
detail: Climb the south-eastern ladder and use the blindweed on the north-western hopper.

label: Ask Braindeath for the next ingredient (stagnant water)
detail: He hands over a bucket if not already held and sends you to a nearby volcano.

label: Fill the bucket with stagnant water at the volcano
detail: Exit south then west past 50% Luke's gate (Ring of charos (a) or a tinderbox on him for optional dialogue) and up the volcano.

label: Pour the stagnant water into the hopper
detail: Return to the house and add the water to the hopper, then talk to Braindeath.

label: Catch 5 sluglings (or karamthulhu) at the nearby fishing spot
detail: Braindeath hands over a fishbowl tangled in a net (use them on each other if untangled). Fish at the spot by the farming patch.

label: Add the sluglings to the pressure barrel and pull the lever
detail: Upstairs next to the hopper; pulling the lever sets the brewing apparatus spinning.

label: Get the wrench blessed by Davey
detail: Former priest Davey, west side of the house, only blesses the wrench with 47+ available Prayer points (does not drain Prayer).
