label: Beat the possessed controls and kill the Evil spirit
detail: Hit the controls south of Braindeath with the blessed wrench; a level-150 Evil spirit attacks — negate with Protect from Melee or a Ranged/Magic/halberd safespot.

label: Learn the final ingredient is a fever spider carcass
detail: Complete the full dialogue with Braindeath or the carcass will not drop from the kill.

label: Kill a fever spider in the basement for its carcass
detail: Fever spiders inflict disease even through Protect from Melee; negate with a safespot, Slayer gloves, or a cure such as Relicym's balm.

hints.value: Killing the fever spider also completes a medium Morytania Diary task.

label: Add the fever spider carcass to the hopper
detail: Finishes the rum recipe.

label: Collect the finished 'rum' from the output tap
detail: South end of the machinery; Braindeath supplies a bucket if not already held.

label: Give the 'rum' to Captain Donnie
detail: Found near the farming patches; he downs it and accidentally names his boss, Rabid Jack.

label: Report Rabid Jack's name to Braindeath to finish
detail: He is shocked, then thanks you and confirms the brewery stays put.

label: Slice a banana into Karamjan rum
detail: Pick a banana at the Musa Point plantation, buy Karamjan rum at the Karamja Spirits Bar, slice the banana with a knife/spear, then add the slice to the rum before leaving the island (leaving unslied breaks it).

label: Talk to Timfraku to start the quest
detail: Upstairs in the north-west house of Tai Bwo Wannai (fairy ring CKR); mention Trufitus sent you, then ask "So far??" to receive the task of reuniting his three sons.

label: Ask Tamayu about the Shaikahan
detail: South-east of the village at the mine; talk twice, asking when he'll succeed and offering to join his next hunt. A cutscene shows him failing against The Shaikahan.

label: Net-fish 20+ raw karambwanji at the Holy Lake
detail: South-west of Tamayu; keep a few spares in case of a low Cooking level burning the karambwan later.

label: Become Lubufu's karambwan apprentice
detail: By the south-eastern Brimhaven shore; ask his age, offer to help collect bait, catch and hand over 20 karambwanji, then ask about his catching method and become his apprentice to unlock the karambwan vessel and 65-Fishing raw karambwan catching (1500 Fishing xp).

hints.value: Collect extra vessels here (drop and re-ask Lubufu) — one each for Tiadeche, Tinsay, and yourself.

label: Give Tiadeche a full karambwan vessel
detail: North-east corner of the Karamja jungle (fairy ring DKP); fill a vessel with karambwanji first, then hand it over for a raw karambwan (vessel is not returned).

label: Grab seaweed on the beach near Tiadeche
detail: Spawns on the beach by Tiadeche; needed later for Tinsay's seaweed sandwich.

label: Cook the karambwan and grind it into paste
detail: Cook the raw karambwan into a poison karambwan, then grind it with a pestle and mortar into karambwan paste (use the "use" option, not eat, to avoid damage).

label: Poison the spear with karambwan paste
detail: Any of iron/steel/mithril/adamant/rune/dragon spear works; do NOT give it to Tamayu before poisoning it.

label: Get jogre bones on the way back to Tamayu
detail: Kill a Jogre en route back south (also a fallback source for an iron spear if none carried).

label: Give Tamayu the poisoned spear and 4-dose agility potion
detail: Cross the agility shortcut back to the mine; use the poisoned spear then a full 4-dose agility potion on him (can be topped up over multiple potions), then join his hunt for a successful cutscene.

label: Kill a monkey and have Tamayu skin it
detail: Ranged/Magic/halberd only (melee does 0 damage); use the corpse on Tamayu to skin it and keep the monkey skin (saves a Tinsay trip later).

label: Climb to Cairn Isle and talk to Tinsay
detail: Up the rockslide (Agility 15) and across the bridge; he asks for three items to regain his sanity and repair the Tribal Statue.

label: Give Tinsay the banana rum
detail: First of his three requests.

label: Make and deliver a seaweed sandwich
detail: Combine the seaweed and monkey skin into a seaweed sandwich (do not combine before skinning, or it becomes a joke item), then give it to Tinsay.

label: Give Tinsay a spare karambwan vessel
detail: Unlocks the Crafting manual for Tiadeche (he won't hand it over until the sandwich is delivered).

label: Burn, grind, paste, and cook jogre bones into marinated bones
detail: Burn jogre bones on a tinderbox (Firemaking 30+) or a furnace/Superheat Item if lower; grind a raw karambwanji into paste and add it to the burnt bones; cook the result on a range or fire until green (white means it was done in the wrong order).

label: Give Tinsay the marinated jogre bones
detail: His third request; he regains his sanity and agrees to return to the village.

label: Bring the Crafting manual back to Tiadeche
detail: Both brothers then head back to Tai Bwo Wannai.

label: Talk to Timfraku to finish the quest
detail: Same north-west house; completes the quest. Afterward, talk to each brother in their village house to claim their individual xp rewards.

label: Talk to Rantz to start the quest
detail: Rantz the ogre is south-east of Gu'Tanoth (Fairy ring AKS, Feldip Hills teleport, or gnome glider). The quest must be started by talking to him first, and he only accepts arrows you make yourself.

label: Kill 4 level-64 wolves for wolf bones
detail: In the crater south-west of Rantz; safespottable near the north-east swamp roots.

label: Chisel the wolf bones into wolfbone arrowtips
detail: Each bone yields 2-6 tips at random.

label: Chop 4 achey trees for logs
detail: Growing near Rantz.

label: Knife the achey logs into ogre arrow shafts
Feather the shafts into flighted ogre arrows
Attach wolfbone arrowtips to the flighted arrows
detail: Finishes at least 6 usable ogre arrows for the hand-in.

label: Hand at least 6 ogre arrows to Rantz
detail: He explains the swamp toads his children play with; ask him every listed question or the chest cannot be opened later.

hints.value: Ask every dialogue option offered, not just the minimum — required to open the chest later.

label: Enter the cave and talk to Fycie and Bugs
detail: North of Rantz; they explain their ogre bellows are locked in a rock-weighted chest.

label: Unlock the chest and search it for the bellows
detail: Failed unlock attempts reduce Strength by 1; search immediately after opening or it re-locks.

hints.value: Keep the bellows afterward if planning Mourning's End Part I and/or Recipe for Disaster.

label: Inflate 3 swamp toads into bloated toads
detail: South-west of Rantz at the swamp (also findable near poison spiders in the Yanille Agility dungeon); the bellows hold 3 charges before needing a refill at the swamp bubbles.

hints.value: Carrying capacity for bloated toads is 3 — inflating more replaces one already held.

label: Return to Rantz to learn the lure spot
detail: He shows the flashing arrow tile where toads should be dropped to lure a chompy bird.

label: Offer to shoot for Rantz and receive the ogre bow
detail: After his first miss (he blames the arrows), offer to help; he hands over his ogre bow.

label: Lure and kill a chompy bird with the ogre bow
detail: Drop a bloated toad on the marked tile and stand back but in view; range the bird once it appears (re-bait if the lure fails). You must land the kill yourself — a bought/traded raw chompy will not progress the quest.

hints.value: Purchasing a raw chompy bird instead of killing one yourself will NOT progress the quest — confirmed on the quest's own page, not a real GE-alternative.

label: Pluck the chompy and bring it back to Rantz
detail: He asks for it cooked with a seasoning of his children's choosing.

label: Ask Fycie and Bugs what seasoning they want
detail: Two of three needed ingredients (onion, doogle leaves, equa leaves, tomato, potato, cabbage) are randomised per player; only one bird is cooked.

label: Gather the 3 requested seasoning ingredients around the area
detail: Onion/tomato near the fire west-south-west of Rantz; doogle leaves to the west by the glider; equa leaves on the south-east peninsula; potato south-east near the equa spawns; cabbage scattered south-west/south-east — pick another plant if a seed drops instead.

label: Cook the chompy with all 3 seasonings on the spit
detail: North of Rantz; hold all three ingredients plus the raw chompy.

label: Present the seasoned chompy to Rantz to finish
detail: Completes the quest.

label: Ask Grish about the sick ogres
detail: Speak with Grish in Jiggig and offer to help investigate the zombified ogres.

hints.value: What do you mean sickies? -> Can I help in any way? -> Yes.

label: Get the ogre guard to remove the barricade
detail: Speak to the Ogre guard east of Grish so he clears the way into the Zogre-infested area.

label: Climb the barricade and descend into the cave
detail: Climb over the crushed barricade, run east to the stairs, and go down them.

label: Search the skeleton and defeat the zombie it spawns
detail: Search the skeleton next to the broken lecturn; a zombie appears and must be killed to get the ruined backpack.

hints.value: Under 89 combat, Zogre/Skogre attacks from here on can cause disease that lowers a random skill 10 levels roughly every minute -- carry super restore potions.

label: Open the ruined backpack
detail: Open the backpack to obtain a Dragon inn tankard, rotten food, and a knife.

label: Search the broken lecturn for the torn page
detail: Search the broken lecturn and keep the torn page it holds.

label: Cut open the coffin and search it for the black prism
detail: Use the knife on the coffin west of the skeleton, then search it (may take a few tries) for the black prism.

label: Show the tankard to the Yanille bartender
detail: Go to the Dragon Inn in Yanille and use the Dragon inn tankard on the bartender to begin identifying its owner.

label: Speak to Zavistic Rarve at the Wizards' Guild
detail: Find Zavistic Rarve inside the Wizards' Guild in Yanille (ring the bell out front if you lack the level to enter).

hints.value: I'm here about the sicks...err Zogres (only if Hand in the Sand already started)

label: Speak to the bedridden Sithik Ints
detail: Sithik is bedridden in the upstairs bedroom of the guest house north of the Wizards' Guild; ask to look around his room.

hints.value: Do you mind if I look around?

label: Search Sithik's drawers, cupboard, and wardrobe
detail: Search all three pieces of furniture in the room for a portraiture book, necromancy book, papyrus, charcoal, and a Book of H.A.M.

hints.value: More papyrus can be found here if a re-sketch is needed later.

label: Read all three found books
detail: Read the portraiture book, necromancy book, and Book of H.A.M before acting on them.

label: Use all three books on Sithik
detail: Use the portraiture book, necromancy book, and Book of H.A.M on Sithik in turn.

label: Use papyrus on Sithik to sketch his portrait
detail: Use papyrus on Sithik to sketch a portrait whose examine text must read a classic realist charcoal portrait of Sithik.

hints.value: A low Crafting level (1-10) reduces the odds of sketching a correct portrait on the first try; 20+ Crafting is recommended to speed this up -- soft speed factor, not a hard requirement.

label: Show the sketched portrait to Sithik
detail: Use the portrait on Sithik; he must appreciate its honesty, not just its truth.

label: Return to the Dragon Inn
detail: Head back to the Dragon Inn in Yanille to get the portrait signed.

label: Have the bartender sign the portrait
detail: Use the tankard then the portrait on the bartender; he signs the portrait as an affidavit.

label: Return to the Wizards' Guild
detail: Head back to Zavistic Rarve at the Wizards' Guild with the evidence in hand.

label: Present the evidence to Zavistic Rarve
detail: Speak to Zavistic Rarve while holding the necromancy book, Book of H.A.M, the tankard, and the signed portrait to receive a strange potion.

hints.value: I have some items that I'd like you to look at.
Text doesn't explicitly say whether the 4 items are truly consumed here vs merely checked -- modeled as consumed.

label: Spike Sithik's tea
detail: Use the strange potion on the cup of tea on top of Sithik's drawers.

label: Reset Sithik's dialogue by leaving and returning
detail: Go downstairs then back upstairs so Sithik has drunk the spiked tea before you talk to him.

label: Get the three secrets out of Sithik
detail: Question Sithik for the cures to the disease, the removal of the undead ogres, and the effects of the spell -- needed for Relicym's balm and Brutal arrows.

hints.value: How do I remove the effects of the spell from the area? / How do I get rid of the undead ogres / How do I get rid of the disease / Sorry, I have to go.

label: Report the culprit to Grish
detail: Tell Grish you found who's responsible for the Zogres; he gives you an ogre gate key for the ceremonial chamber.

hints.value: I found who's responsible for the Zogres being here.

label: Learn to equip a composite ogre bow
detail: Ask Grish about an easier way to kill Zogres to learn how to equip composite ogre bows.

label: Chop an achey tree for logs
detail: Optional: cut an achey tree for logs to make a composite ogre bow instead of relying on Crumble Undead.

hints.value: Optional side-path; not required to finish the quest.

label: Make an unstrung comp bow
detail: Use a knife on the achey tree logs with wolf bones in your inventory and select box 2 to create an unstrung comp bow.

label: String the composite ogre bow
detail: String the unstrung bow with a bow string to finish it.

label: Brew Relicym's balm
detail: Optional: add a Rogue's purse to a vial of water then add snake weed to brew Relicym's balm; not needed for the quest itself but unlocks purchasing more from Uglug Nar.

hints.value: ge_violation: page also lists 'buy one from the Grand Exchange' as an alternative -- excluded per the never-GE-buy hard rule; only the gather/produce path is modeled.

label: Cut achey trees for arrow logs
detail: Optional: cut achey trees for logs to fletch brutal arrows instead of buying them.

hints.value: ge_violation: page also says 'if you have access to the Grand Exchange, just buy the arrows and skip this section' -- excluded per the never-GE-buy hard rule.

label: Fletch the logs into ogre arrow shafts
detail: Fletch the achey tree logs with a knife into ogre arrow shafts.

label: Add feathers to the arrow shafts
detail: Add feathers to the ogre arrow shafts to make flighted ogre arrows.

label: Nail the flighted arrows into brutal arrows
detail: With a hammer in your inventory, use nails on the flighted ogre arrows to finish them.

label: Head to the ceremonial chamber
detail: Return to Jiggig, travel west through both sets of doors, then go down the stairs.

label: Search the stand at the end of the chamber
detail: Follow the chamber to its end and search the stand to approach Slash Bash.

hints.value: No item result is stated for this search -- treated as a pure trigger.

label: Kill Slash Bash
detail: Fight the level-111 Slash Bash, who uses both Ranged and Melee; safe-spot with Protect from Missiles or use Crumble Undead.

label: Return to Grish to finish
detail: Report Slash Bash's defeat to Grish to complete the quest.

label: Search the shelf in the SW ruined house to start
detail: Also search the smashed table in the same building for 2 free tarromin + a Rogue's purse (keep the purse for Zogre Flesh Eaters); a spare vial spawn is here too.

label: Brew 2 doses of Serum 207
detail: Use tarromin on a vial of water to make tarromin potion (unf) if not already carried, then add ashes to finish. Make two doses.

hints.value: Serum 207 can be bought on the GE, but at least one dose must be player-made for this quest step to register — gather/produce path modeled, GE not used.

label: Use Serum 207 on Razmire Keelgan and learn about the shades
detail: In the general store; he explains the shades are restless spirits and asks for 5 Loar Shade remains.

label: Kill 5 level-40 Loar Shades for their remains
detail: Kills only count toward the task once Razmire has asked for them; remains come from the kill itself.

label: Give Razmire 2 shade remains
detail: Use Serum 207 on him again, then he takes 2 remains for experiments and mentions Ulsquire Shauncy.

label: Buy olive oil and temple building materials from Razmire's stores
detail: General store: olive oil. Builders' store (Razmire opens it): timber beam, limestone brick, swamp paste (Flamtaer hammer optional, ~13,000gp, highly recommended if the minigame is unpopulated).

label: Cure Ulsquire Shauncy and learn about the temple
detail: House south-east of Razmire's; give a Serum 207 dose then a shade remain, then ask both "What did you find out about the remains?" and "What can you tell me about that temple?" (both required or the temple can't be interacted with).

label: Repair the temple to full and light the sacred flame
detail: Minigame on the island NE of the general store: use a hammer/Flamtaer hammer and building materials to repair the walls (Crafting 20); sanctity accrues from repairing/reinforcing or killing Loar Shades. World 377 is the dedicated minigame world if solo repair is too slow.

label: Pour olive oil on the sacred flame for sacred oil
detail: Requires at least 10% Sanctity from the temple repair.

label: Dip the remaining Serum 207 in the flame for Serum 208
detail: Optional but highly recommended (permanently cures Razmire/Ulsquire); needs 20%+ Sanctity.

label: Cut a dead tree for logs if none carried
detail: Near the funeral pyres, west of the general store.

label: Combine sacred oil with logs into a pyre log
Light the pyre log with the shade remains on a funeral pyre
detail: Use the pyre log then the remaining loar shade remains on one of the stone-pillar funeral pyres, then light it (25 Prayer xp) and collect the reward from the pillar.

label: Talk to Ulsquire to finish (re-serum him if needed)
detail: Use a Serum 207/208 dose first if he has reverted to being afflicted, then speak to him to complete the quest.

label: Talk to an Examiner and fail the first exam
detail: At the Exam Centre south of the Digsite; ask about taking an exam for an unstamped letter, then get the letter sealed by Curator Haig Halen at Varrock Museum before retrying — any answer fails the first attempt, prompting you to consult the students.

label: Get the letter sealed by Curator Haig Halen
detail: Varrock Museum, east side of the city.

label: Search the hilltop bush for the missing teddy bear
detail: North of the Exam Centre, east walkway, easternmost bush by the large blue urn.

label: Pan the river for the special cup
detail: Take a panning tray from the tent table, use a cup of tea on the panning guide, then pan the river east of the tent.

hints.value: Panning has a small chance to also yield an uncut opal, needed later for the level-3 exam — keep it if received here.

label: Pickpocket Digsite workmen for the animal skull
detail: Repeat until the skull drops.

hints.value: A specimen brush needed later can also drop from these pickpockets — keep it if received here.

label: Deliver the teddy, cup, and skull to the three lost-item students
detail: Blonde/green-shirt student (animal skull) north of the tent; orange-shirt student (special cup) further north-east; purple-clothed female student (teddy bear) north-west — talk to each twice.

label: Retake the exam for the Level 1 certificate
detail: Re-ask each student for their answer, then answer the Examiner's 3 questions correctly.

label: Retake the exam for the Level 2 certificate
detail: Re-consult all three students for the new round of answers first.

label: Give the female student an opal for the Level 3 answer
detail: She additionally demands an opal/uncut opal this round; pan the river again if none is held, hand it over across two conversations.

label: Retake the exam for the Level 3 certificate
detail: Consult all three students once more, then answer correctly for full digging permission.

hints.value: Certificates can later be exchanged with the Museum Curator for a chocolate cake (Desert Treasure I) or fruit blast (Recipe for Disaster) — keep at least the Level 3 certificate for that.

label: Take a specimen jar from the Exam Centre cupboard
detail: South wall inside the Exam Centre; speak to Terry Balando about the tools first if there's no search option.

label: Dig a level-3 site with the trowel for the ancient talisman
detail: South-westernmost or northernmost level-3 dig site; can take several minutes of repeated attempts.

label: Bring the talisman to Terry Balando
detail: He identifies it as a talisman of Zaros and grants an invitation letter for the private dig shafts.

label: Show the invitation letter to a workman by the west winch
detail: Must be the pickpocketable 'Digsite workman' near a winch, not the plain 'Dig site workman'.

label: Rope down the west winch into the sublevels
detail: Requires Agility 15 to operate; grab an arcenia root just north of the rope landing and search the bricks blocking the south-east path.

label: Rope down the north-east winch and talk to Doug Deeping
detail: Ask how to move the rock pile blocking the way; he hands over a chest key.

label: Unlock the chest in the panning tent for chemical powder
Open the centre barrel with the trowel and fill a vial
detail: Deals 25 non-fatal damage and breaks the vial if dropped after filling — do not drop it.

label: Get charcoal if not already carried
detail: Search the specimen tray north of the tent with a specimen jar held, if charcoal was not brought.

label: Have Terry Balando identify the powder and liquid
detail: Use the chemical powder on him (ammonium nitrate), then the unidentified liquid (nitroglycerin) without dropping/emptying it; read the Book on chemicals on a nearby bookshelf first if he won't identify it.

label: Combine powder, liquid, charcoal, and root into a chemical compound
detail: Ammonium nitrate + nitroglycerin -> mixed chemicals (Herblore 6); grind charcoal with pestle and mortar -> ground charcoal; add ground charcoal to mixed chemicals (Herblore 8); add arcenia root to finish (Herblore 10). Dropping the finished compound deals 65 non-fatal damage.

label: Blast the bricks open and enter the chamber
detail: Down the western winch: use the chemical compound on the bricks, then a tinderbox to detonate; watch for level-22 skeletons if under 45 Combat.

label: Pick up the stone tablet in the exposed chamber
Hand the stone tablet to Terry Balando to finish
detail: He remarks on the Saradomin cover-up of the Zaros altar and rewards 2 gold bars.

label: Climb the Watchtower trellis and talk to the wizard
detail: Climb the trellis (Agility 18) on the north side of the Watchtower, north-west of Yanille, then the ladder. The wizard explains the tower's ogre-repelling spell has failed because its power crystals were stolen.

label: Search the north-west bush for Skavid fingernails
detail: Other bushes yield red-herring items only (old robe, unusual armour, damaged dagger, tattered eye patch).

label: Show the wizard the fingernails to learn about the relic
detail: He identifies them as Skavid and explains the ogres stole 4 power crystals; you'll need pieces of an ogre relic from three tribe chieftains to enter the ogre city.

label: Talk to Og at the north-west ogre tribe
detail: Through Yanille's west gate or the agility shortcut, bank first for armour/food/2 ropes/1 dragon bones. Og's nemesis Toban stole his gold bar; he gives you a key to Toban's chest.

label: Rope-swing to Grew's island south of Og
detail: Long-branched tree on the west shore; the rope is lost on the swing. Grab jangerberries on the island for later.

label: Talk to Grew about his enemy Gorad
detail: He asks you to knock a tooth out of Gorad on the third island.

label: Kill Gorad for a tooth
detail: Level-68 chieftain, south of the ladder on Toban's island (reached via the Skavid caves x4 without a map, or around Gu'Tanoth's south edge, then west through a rock hole past a death rune spawn). Safespottable in the island centre for Ranged/Magic.

label: Give Toban dragon bones for the third relic piece
detail: Baby dragon bones do not work; do not bury them.

label: Open Toban's chest for Og's stolen gold bar
detail: A second rope spawns near the roots south-west of the island's ladder if needed for the swing back.

label: Give Grew the tooth for the second relic piece and the yellow crystal
detail: Rope-swing back to Grew's island; pick jangerberries first if not already held.

label: Give Og his gold bar for the final relic piece
Return the 3 relic pieces to the wizard to assemble the Ogre relic
detail: Pick up a candle from the ground-floor spawn if a light source is still needed.

label: Show the assembled relic to the Ogre guards for entry
detail: North-west trail split into Gu'Tanoth; the relic must be shown via dialogue, not used directly on them.

label: Steal a rock cake from the market food stall
detail: Southern stall in the ogre market; do not left-click (eats it, forcing a re-steal).

label: Buy a pestle and mortar and vial from Grud if needed
detail: Non-aggressive ogre merchant in the market; ~7 coins total.

label: Say you're a friend and hand over the rock cake at the second gate
detail: First dialogue option only, or the guard knocks you out of the area; use (not eat) the rock cake on him.

label: Jump the broken bridge gap and pay the toll
detail: Agility 25 to jump; the guards then ask for 20 coins to let you cross. Grab the knife spawn here for cutting webs later.

label: Solve the city guards' word puzzle with the death rune
detail: The answer is 'death rune'; hand over the death rune picked up earlier south of the rock hole.

label: Learn the Skavid language from the Scared skavid (cave 1)
detail: East of Gu'Tanoth along the south-east branch; promise not to hurt it.

label: Give the correct response to each of the 4 regular Skavids
detail: Cave 2 (NE, main path): "Bidith tanath." -> "Cur." Cave 3 (N, path opening): "Gor cur..." -> "Ar." Cave 4 (N, south of west Yanille gate): "Cur Bidith." -> "Ig." (take 2 Cave nightshade here). Cave 5 (E, east side of the mountain): "Tanath gor." -> "Nod."

label: Return to the Scared skavid to be declared ready for the Mad skavid
Use the gold bar on a guard to reach the Mad skavid's cave
detail: South of the Scared skavid cave along the south-east entrance path; go south and west across a bridge into cave 6.

label: Answer the Mad skavid's randomised word-repeat challenge
detail: One randomised opening line from a fixed 8-line/8-response table (e.g. 'Ar cur'->'Gor', 'Bidith ig'->'Cur', 'Gor nod'->'Tanath', 'Cur tanath'->'Bidith', 'Bidith tanath'->'Cur', 'Tanath gor'->'Nod', 'Cur bidith'->'Ig', 'Gor cur'->'Ar') read directly off the source page's own table; answering correctly grants the magenta crystal. If short on cave nightshade, 2 more spawn just inside.

hints.value: Do not eat the cave nightshade — it damages you; the hole in the corner is a shortcut back to Yanille.

label: Use a nightshade on an Ogre Enclave guard to enter
detail: West cave entrance in the Gu'Tanoth market; talking to the guards directly triggers an attack instead. 'Use'/'eat' options are swapped for nightshade here — do not eat it, and complete the full dialogue or the nightshade is wasted.

label: Run past the shamans and blue dragons to the north-east exit
detail: A cutscene shows an Ogre shaman and Blue dragon; do not talk to or attack shamans (20-30 damage instantly). Exits near a northern Skavid cave facing Yanille.

label: Kill a giant bat behind the webbed house for bat bones
detail: House east of the Watchtower with a web-covered entrance; cut through with a slashing weapon/knife.

label: Brew and enchant the magic ogre potion with the wizard
detail: Order matters: guam leaf + vial of water -> guam potion (unf); add jangerberries (do not left-click-eat them; they respawn on Grew's island if lost); grind bat bones with pestle and mortar then add; hand the finished potion to the wizard to enchant it.

label: Use the second nightshade on a guard to re-enter the Enclave
detail: Bring pickaxe, anti-dragon/dragonfire shield, food. Same use/eat-swapped, dialogue-must-complete rule as the first entry.

label: Use the magic ogre potion on all 6 ogre shamans
detail: Instantly kills each shaman with no damage taken; the last one drops the cyan crystal automatically into your inventory. If lost, a Shaman robe in the SE corner can be searched for a replacement.

label: Mine the Rock of Dalgroth for the last crystal
detail: Centre of the Enclave; only mineable after the shamans are dead. Mine (not prospect) before leaving, or fresh nightshades are needed to return.

label: Place all 4 crystals and pull the lever to finish
detail: Leave via the north-east exit (or a Nightmare Zone teleport); yellow crystal in the south-west pillar, grey in the south-east, cyan in the north-west, magenta in the north-east, then pull the west-side lever. Do not drop anything before pulling the lever or it is lost permanently in the instance.

label: Bank: withdraw Hill Giant loadout
detail: Withdraw: brass key (?? -- source separately if not owned), food ??x, best-available weapon equipped.

label: Go to Edgeville Dungeon (Hill Giant area)
detail: Same Edgeville Dungeon entrance/area as the Strength 40-60 band (tsb) -- reuse the loadout/walk pattern.

label: Kill Hill Giants until Attack 60
detail: Same monster/site as the Strength band; always drops big bones. Alt (atk60-site, optional): reuse existing steps.jsonl row ctr-06-stronghold-crawlers per U8, same caveat as the Strength band -- its until=40/40/40 undershoots attack:60.

label: Bank: deposit Hill Giant loot
detail: Deposit big bones, coins, and any weapon/armour drops.

label: Bank: withdraw Barbarian Village loadout
detail: Food ??x, best-available weapon/armour equipped.

label: Go to Barbarian Village
detail: Barbarians (combat 8-17) spawn throughout the village.

label: Kill Barbarians until Defence 40
detail: Low-level, non-aggressive village NPCs; minimal food needed at this stage.

label: Bank: deposit Barbarian loot
detail: Deposit bones and coins.

label: Bank: withdraw Stronghold loadout
detail: Food ??x; no special items required beyond answering the security-question doors.

label: Go to Stronghold of Security, Catacomb of Famine
detail: Enter via the Barbarian Village hole, answer the security-question doors, descend to the Catacomb of Famine.

label: Kill Flesh Crawlers until Defence 60
detail: Near-AFK at this stat range; claim coin rewards on each floor while passing.

hints.note: Let aggro stack; re-aggro resets on floor exit/re-entry.

label: Alt: assigned Slayer tasks until Defence 60
detail: General combat-task progress toward Defence 60 (task source/assigner ??) -- vague alternative to the Stronghold route, kept per the coarse row's own 'Flesh Crawlers or Slayer tasks' detail.

hints.note: Task rolls vary; not concretely locatable without a specific assigner.

label: Bank: deposit Stronghold loot
detail: Deposit runes, coins, and ashes.

label: Bank: withdraw allotment-run loadout
detail: Seed dibber, rake, spade, potato/onion/cabbage seeds (?? per patch), compost (?? -- see bg-farm-allotment-setup for the background supply loop).

label: Plant allotment seeds until Farming 17
detail: Lumbridge farm patches (potato/onion/cabbage rotation). RECURRING background loop per U7 -- interleaves with banking, not serialized.

hints.note: XREF bg-farm-allotment-setup -- this band rides the same recurring cycle, not a one-shot action.

label: Harvest allotment crops
detail: Harvest each patch once mature; replant immediately to keep the loop running.

label: Bank: deposit allotment produce
detail: Bank surplus produce; keep a few for Cooking/quest use if flagged elsewhere.

label: Bank: withdraw firemaking loadout
detail: Tinderbox equipped/inventoried, normal logs ??x.

label: Go to Varrock West Bank
detail: Burn logs in a row east-to-west near the bank; tile ??.

label: Light logs in a row until Firemaking 15
detail: Light one log per tile walking in a line, bank, repeat.

hints.note: Collecting ashes while burning feeds the Ash sanctifier/Prayer-offering synergy if picked up.

label: Bank: withdraw fletching loadout
detail: Logs ??x, knife equipped, feathers ??x (only needed if finishing headless arrows).

label: Fletch arrow shafts until Fletching 10
detail: 5 xp per log fletched into an arrow shaft; bank-side, no travel required.

label: Fletch unstrung shortbows until Fletching 20
detail: Shortbow (u) covers levels 5-10 per the wiki's own table; continue with the next affordable unstrung-bow tier past 10 (exact per-level tier breakpoints toward 20 ??).

label: Bank: deposit fletched goods
detail: Deposit arrow shafts and unstrung bows for later stringing/selling.

label: Bank: withdraw Hunter loadout
detail: Noose wand + rings of pursuit equipped/inventoried for tracking; box-trap materials (hammer, saw, 2 planks, 4 nails, 2 buckets, fish offcuts) held for the later Pandemonium phase.

label: Go to the Feldip Hunter area
detail: Feldip Hills teleport scroll, then run south near the dungeon icon; tile ??.

label: Catch Feldip weasels until Hunter 15
detail: Inspect a burrow to start tracking, follow the trail, attack the revealed bush to catch the kebbit, repeat.

hints.note: Kebbit can escape mid-track.

label: Go to the Piscatoris Hunter area
detail: Bird-snaring ground for copper longtails; tile ??.

label: Trap copper longtails (ruby harvests) until Hunter 21
detail: Combine with butterfly netting on the same ground for a higher xp/hr per the wiki's own note.

label: Go to The Pandemonium
detail: Requires partial completion of the Pandemonium quest and 10 Construction to build the crab traps -- verify both are met at this route position before relying on this leg (fallback ?? if not).

label: Trap Red crabs until Hunter 29
detail: Build 2 traps next to each other, bait with fish offcuts, bank crabs at a nearby bank.

label: Bank: deposit Hunter catch
detail: Deposit trapped crabs/kebbit byproducts.

label: Bank: withdraw combat-spell loadout
detail: Elemental staff equipped if owned (unlimited matching runes), else runes ??x for the highest affordable combat spell.

label: Go to Sand Crabs (Hosidius south coast)
detail: Same spot as the Ranged crab bands.

label: Cast combat spells on Sand Crabs until Magic 25
detail: Autocast the highest-level affordable combat spell (Air Bolt or better per the coarse row's own detail); reset aggro every ~10 min.

hints.note: Low Alchemy unwanted crab drops while banking -- same page's parallel Levels 21-55 section, synergy not fabrication.

label: Low Alchemy unwanted crab drops (bank-side, optional)
detail: Cast Low Level Alchemy on unwanted equipment drops picked up along the way; also grants Magic xp toward this band.

label: Equip: best available pickaxe
detail: No food needed for this AFK-adjacent method; no-bank checkpoint (ore is dropped, not carried).

label: Go to Al Kharid Mine
detail: One of 16 wiki-listed iron-triangle spots (three iron rocks in reach without moving); tile ??.

label: Mine iron ore until Mining 30
detail: Mine the triangle, drop each ore, repeat -- banking iron ore is not worth the time per the wiki's own advice at this level range.

hints.note: Dropping ore beats banking for xp/hr below level 60 per the wiki's own guidance.

label: Bank: withdraw banked big bones
detail: Withdraw big bones banked from earlier combat bands (Hill Giants always drop them); top up from a non-GE bone vendor if stock is short (vendor ??).

label: Bury big bones until Prayer 43
detail: Manual bone burial -- no location requirement. Gilded altar (350% bonus) needs Construction 75, not assumed available this early; flagged as a later-route upgrade, not this band's default.

hints.note: Bone supply depends on earlier combat-band drop rates.
Construction 75 unlocks a much faster offering rate -- revisit this band once available.

label: Bank: withdraw ranged-training loadout
detail: Best available darts/bow+arrows, food ??x.

label: Go to Sand Crabs (Hosidius south coast)
detail: East of the Hosidius vinery; pick a spot with 2-3 aggressive spawns.

label: Kill Sand Crabs until Ranged 30
detail: 60 HP, very low Defence; auto-retaliate and reset aggro every ~10 min by running a minimap's length away.

hints.note: Crabs are xp-only; no meaningful loot policy.
Hosidius spots are usually crowded -- Avium Savannah is a lower-competition alternative per the wiki.

label: Bank: withdraw ranged-training loadout
detail: Best available darts/bow+arrows, food ??x.

label: Go to Sand Crabs (Hosidius south coast)
detail: Same spot as the Ranged 1-30 band -- continuation, not a new site.

label: Kill Sand Crabs until Ranged 40
detail: Level 60 Defence unlocks the odium ward upgrade; not required at this stage.

label: Bank: withdraw ranged-training loadout
detail: Best available darts/bow+arrows, food ??x.
