label: Pick the mushroom from the log
detail: Quickly pick the mushroom that grows from the log after the spell is cast, then bring it back to Filliman's camp.

label: Solve the three-stone puzzle
detail: Make sure Filliman is standing outside between all three stones. Use the mushroom on the light-brown stone, the used spell card on the grey stone, then stand on the orange stone and tell him you've solved the puzzle.

hints.note: I think I've solved the puzzle!

label: Give the nature spirit your sickle
detail: Enter the hole under the tree, search the grotto in the middle of the cave, then give the nature spirit your silver sickle by talking to him; he blesses it and hands you a druid pouch.

label: Fill the druid pouch with swamp plants
detail: Leave the grotto and stand next to rotting logs, bushes, or branches in the swamp. Use the silver sickle (b)'s Bloom ability (costs prayer points) to harvest fungi/saplings/pears and fill the druid pouch.

label: Kill three Ghasts
detail: Use your filled druid pouch on a Ghast to make it attackable, then kill three of them (level 30 each).

label: Complete the grotto restoration
detail: Return to the nature spirit via the grotto in the cave; he redecorates the grotto and the quest completes. If aiming for the Morytania Diary, pray at the altar here first.

label: Ask the Warrior about Zanaris
detail: Speak to the Warrior camped north-west of Lumbridge Swamp and ask what he's guarding and who Zanaris is.

hints.note: What are you camped here for? -> Who's Zanaris? -> If it's hidden how are you planning to find it? -> Looks like you don't know either.

label: Chop (don't chop down) the nearby tree
detail: Go to the tree closest to the Warrior's encampment and right-click it, choosing the 'chop' option rather than 'chop down'. This makes Shamus appear.

label: Speak to Shamus
detail: Talk to Shamus about how the camp fits in a shed.

hints.note: How does it fit in a shed then?

label: Bank weapons and armour before Entrana
detail: Deposit all weapons and armour at a bank (jewellery such as a ring of dueling, amulet of glory, or combat bracelet is allowed) — Entrana's monks confiscate anything else. Optionally buy a chronicle from Diango and charge it with teleport cards if you lack a teleport to Entrana (not required, just convenient for repeat trips).

label: Travel to the Port Sarim docks
detail: Head to the Port Sarim docks, south of the Rusty Anchor Inn.

label: Sail to Entrana
detail: Talk to a Monk of Entrana at the docks to travel to the island.

label: Reach the cave on Entrana
detail: Cross the north-east bridge, go west to find the Cave monk, then go down the ladder. Do not craft a battlestaff or bow before entering the cave, or the monks will knock you out and send you back to Port Sarim.

label: Farm zombies for a bronze axe
detail: Kill zombies in the cave until one drops a bronze axe (roughly 40% drop chance per kill, so exact kill count is "??"). Two level-92 Greater Demons occupy the room before the Dramen tree — be careful.

label: Reach the Dramen tree
detail: Go south-east past the Greater Demons and attempt to chop the Dramen tree. Caution: the nearby magical door teleports you into level-32 Wilderness.

label: Defeat the Dramen Tree Spirit
detail: Chopping the tree summons the Dramen Tree Spirit; kill it (there's a safespot behind the southern fungus formation). Do not use the mushroom near the demons as a safespot — even after killing the spirit once, it respawns the next time you try to chop.

label: Chop dramen branches
detail: Chop the now-unguarded Dramen tree with the bronze axe. Cutting at least three branches is recommended — spares are useful later for the Freeing Sir Amik Varze RFD subquest and for smuggling into Thorvald's trial in the Fremennik Trials — but don't make them into staves yet.

label: Carve a dramen staff
detail: Use a knife on a dramen branch to make a dramen staff.

label: Return to the Lumbridge Swamp tool shed
detail: Teleport out of the cave, then travel to the tool shed in the centre of Lumbridge Swamp.

label: Enter Zanaris
detail: Wield the dramen staff and enter the tool shed — it opens onto Zanaris and completes the quest.

label: Go to Phileas Rimor's house
detail: Head to the house west of the Cloak and Stagger tavern in Shayzien (from Xeric's Talisman - Xeric's Lookout, run north-west; fairy ring code DJR also reaches Shayzien).

label: Agree to help Phileas Rimor
detail: Speak to Phileas Rimor and agree to help with his investigation.

hints.note: Do you need help with anything? -> Yes.

label: Ready a ranged, melee, and magic loadout
detail: Make sure you're carrying a ranged weapon, a melee weapon (a pickaxe counts), and runes for a magic attack — needed for the Tower of Magic puzzle ahead. Own combat gear, not a quest-specific item to source.

label: Travel to the Arceuus Library
detail: Travel to the Arceuus Library via fairy ring code CIS or the Lovakengj Minecart Network.

label: Ask Archeio for the Historical Archive
detail: Speak to Archeio, who teleports you to the Library Historical Archive.

label: Ask Pagida about King Shayzien VII
detail: Speak to Pagida, ask about King Shayzien VII, and agree to be teleported into the Tower of Magic prison.

hints.note: I have a question about King Shayzien VII. -> Yes please.

label: Push the device and attack with magic
detail: Push the strange device all the way west, then attack it with magic from the north side.

label: Attack the device with melee
detail: From the south side, attack the device using melee. Make sure NPC attack options aren't set to hidden or the option won't appear.

label: Push the device east and attack with ranged
detail: Push the device all the way east, then from the south side attack it using ranged.

label: Investigate the skeleton
detail: Investigate the skeleton in the northern cell.

label: Report back to Phileas Rimor
detail: Return to the quest start and talk to Phileas Rimor again (Xeric's Talisman - Xeric's Lookout, run north-west).

label: Head to the War Tent
detail: Go north-west to the War Tent in the south-west corner of the Shayzien Encampment and climb upstairs.

label: Speak to Lord Shiro Shayzien
detail: Speak to Lord Shiro Shayzien upstairs in the War Tent.

label: Travel to Mount Quidamortem's summit
detail: Travel to the summit of Mount Quidamortem via the Lovakengj Minecart Network, Xeric's Talisman (Xeric's Honour, if unlocked), or fairy ring code BLS (if unlocked). Optionally speak to the Mountain Guide here to unlock quick travel for later trips.

label: Speak to Historian Duffy
detail: Speak to Historian Duffy, found near the water symbol on the minimap.

label: Enter the mountain crevice
detail: Use a rope on the crevice on the western side of the mountain and enter it, then go around to the south — not through the middle (near the exclamation-mark symbol on the minimap).

label: Mine the boulder
detail: Mine the boulder blocking the passage.

label: Push the boulder aside
detail: Push the mined boulder out of the way.

label: Defeat the Corrupt Lizardman
detail: Attempt to pass the magic gate; a Corrupt Lizardman blocks it — kill it.

label: Inspect the Unstable Altar
detail: Pass through the magic gate and inspect the Unstable Altar.

label: Hop worlds to leave the cave
detail: Once the dialogue finishes, hop worlds to quickly leave the cave.

label: Speak to Duffy again
detail: Speak to Historian Duffy again on the mountain.

label: Return to the unstable altar
detail: Go back into the cave to the unstable altar.

label: Speak to both Duffy and Gnosi
detail: Speak to Duffy, then to Gnosi, near the unstable altar — make sure to talk to BOTH of them.

label: Report to Lord Shiro Shayzien
detail: Speak to Lord Shiro Shayzien back at the War Tent (fairy ring code DJR or the Lovakengj Minecart Network), or speak to the Mountain Guide if quick travel was unlocked earlier.

label: Check Phileas's empty house
detail: Return to Phileas's house and walk inside to trigger dialogue — he won't physically be there.

label: Finish the investigation
detail: Return to Lord Shiro Shayzien once more to complete the quest.

label: Accept King Narnode's request
detail: Speak to King Narnode Shareen at the Grand Tree and agree to investigate the missing 10th squad. Keep an inventory slot free or the gnome royal seal drops on the ground.

hints.note: start: ask about the missing 10th squad

label: Glide to Gandius
detail: Climb up the tree at the Grand Tree and take the gnome glider to Gandius.

label: Get monkey bones if needed
detail: If you don't already have monkey bones, kill a monkey nearby for some (if Tai Bwo Wannai Trio is already started, only a monkey corpse drops, which also works).

label: Enter the Shipyard gate
detail: Enter the Shipyard gate to the north, carrying the Royal Seal.

label: Speak with G.L.O. Caranock
detail: Speak with G.L.O. Caranock in the building south of the Shipyard gate.

label: Report back to King Narnode
detail: Return to King Narnode and speak to him. Keep 1 free inventory slot, or Narnode's orders drop to the floor.

label: Talk through every option with Daero
detail: Talk to Daero in the bar on the first floor (east side) of the Grand Tree, working through every dialogue option in turn, to be teleported to a new location.

label: Talk to Daero inside the hangar
detail: Talk (not "travel") to Daero again, now inside the hangar.

label: Solve the hangar sliding puzzle
detail: Click the panel in the south-eastern hangar and solve the sliding puzzle, or alternatively pay Glough back at the Stronghold to solve it for you.

label: Fly to Crash Island
detail: Watch the cutscene, then talk to Daero, then to Waydar, to fly to Crash Island.

hints.note: Yes

label: Speak to Lumdo
detail: Talk to Lumdo on Crash Island.

label: Have Waydar convince Lumdo
detail: Talk (not "travel") to Waydar twice so he convinces Lumdo to follow orders.

hints.note: I cannot convince Lumdo to take us to the island.

label: Sail to Ape Atoll
detail: Talk to Lumdo again to travel west to Ape Atoll.

label: Enter the valley and get arrested
detail: Follow the red path into the valley on Ape Atoll. You'll be shot and arrested by the guards.

label: Pick the cell lock and escape
detail: Watch the guards' patrol pattern, pick the lock on your cell door with a lockpick, and escape. Stay at least 2 squares away from the guards, even while inside the cell.

label: Talk to Garkor
detail: Follow the green path and talk to Garkor, completing the full dialogue (skipping it means Zooknock won't give the m'speak amulet later).

label: Find the monkey dentures
detail: Follow the blue path to the U-shaped building and enter through the southern door, staying on the dark-brown floor to avoid alerting guards. Search the stacked crates on the light-brown floor for Monkey dentures.

label: Fall into the cave below
detail: Heal up first (fall damage applies), then search the south-eastern crate to fall into a cave below.

label: Find the M'amulet mould
detail: Search the north-western crates in the cave for a M'amulet mould, then you may teleport away safely.

label: Mine a gold ore
detail: Mine a gold ore (Mining 40, pickaxe) at a gold rock. Exact nearest rock to the quest's travel path is unconfirmed this pass ("??") — any gold rock works, this is a generic material, not a quest-location-specific one.

label: Smelt the gold bar
detail: Smelt the gold ore into a gold bar at any furnace (Smithing 40, boostable), or cast Superheat Item (Magic 43) to skip the furnace trip.

label: Shear a sheep for wool
detail: Shear a sheep with a pair of shears to collect wool — any sheep pen near your bank works (e.g. Lumbridge or Falador).

label: Spin the wool into a ball
detail: Spin the wool into a ball of wool on a spinning wheel (Crafting 1).

label: Descend into the Ape Atoll Dungeon
detail: Resupply at a bank (good food, prayer/antipoison/stamina potions), return to Ape Atoll via Daero, Waydar, and Lumdo, follow the yellow path west, and climb down the ladder into the Ape Atoll Dungeon.

label: Fight through to Zooknock
detail: Run through the dungeon to Zooknock, keeping Protect from Melee active against the level-98 Monkey Zombies and level-142 Skeletons, eating and drinking potions as needed.

label: Speak to Zooknock
detail: Talk to Zooknock, the exiled monkey blacksmith.

label: Have Zooknock forge the enchanted bar
detail: Use your Monkey dentures, M'amulet mould, and gold bar on Zooknock, then talk to him to receive the Enchanted bar and get your mould back. Do not give him the mould a second time once you already have the bar, or he'll keep it.

label: Reach the temple with the wall of flames
detail: Teleport away then return (Daero, Waydar, Lumdo). Follow the red path, get arrested and escape again, then follow the pink path to the temple. Bearded guards can't be walked through — enter the trapdoor, then navigate via the ladder to avoid the gorillas.

label: Forge the M'speak amulet
detail: With the M'amulet mould in your inventory, use the Enchanted bar with the wall of flames, then string the result with your ball of wool to create the M'speak amulet.

label: Head to the Monkey child's house
detail: Follow the pink path back to the jail, then the cyan path to the Monkey child's house. Watch for the Monkey's Aunt — it's only safe in the garden while she's away.

label: Convince the monkey child
detail: Equip the M'speak amulet and talk to the monkey child, then talk to him twice more to trigger "Well I'll be a monkey's uncle!"

hints.note: Well I'll be a monkey's uncle! -> How many bananas did Aunty want?

label: Pick 5 bananas
detail: Pick 5 bananas from the trees in the garden.

label: Deliver the bananas
detail: Give the bananas to the monkey child, leave the garden, wait for the aunt to pass through, then talk to him again to receive a Monkey talisman.

label: Return to Zooknock for the greegree
detail: Teleport away then return (Daero, Waydar, Lumdo), resupply at a bank, and follow the yellow path down into the Ape Atoll Dungeon again.

label: Trade for a greegree
detail: Give Zooknock a Monkey talisman and Monkey bones from a regular monkey (not another type) to receive a Greegree. Be careful not to accidentally bury the bones, and don't leave the Zooknock dialogue early or you'll have to restart the cutscene.

label: Prepare at the Ardougne Zoo
detail: Head to the Ardougne Zoo, equip the Karamjan monkey greegree, and talk to the Monkey minder (click through any first-time dialogue).

label: Bag a monkey
detail: Equip the M'speak amulet and talk to a nearby monkey so it jumps into your bag. Remove the greegree and speak to the minder again.

label: Walk back to Ape Atoll on foot
detail: Travel by foot (walk or run) back to the Grand Tree — do not use any teleportation method — then return to Ape Atoll by talking to Daero, Waydar, and Lumdo.

label: Reach King Awowogei
detail: Equip the M'speak amulet and Karamjan monkey greegree — Ape Atoll is no longer hostile while wearing it. Follow the red path through the gates, talk to Garkor, then the nearby Elder Guard, then head to the west coast, climb the hill, cross the bridge, and talk to Kruk.

label: Speak with King Awowogei
detail: Talk to Awowogei twice, then talk to the Elder Guard again to be let out.

label: Receive the 10th squad sigil
detail: Talk to Garkor and watch the cutscene, then talk to him again to receive the 10th squad sigil.

label: Prepare for the Jungle Demon
detail: Prepare combat equipment for the final fight — good food, prayer potions, and high-healing food are strongly recommended.

label: Defeat the Jungle Demon
detail: Equip the 10th squad sigil, then fight the Jungle Demon. Use Protect from Magic and stay out of melee range to minimise damage.

label: Report victory to King Narnode
detail: Return to the Grand Tree and talk to King Narnode Shareen to complete the quest.

label: Talk to the Cook (start Cook's Assistant)
detail: The Cook is in Lumbridge Castle's kitchen, panicking over the Duke's birthday cake. Agree to fetch a bucket of milk, an egg, and a pot of flour for him.

label: Grab an empty bucket in the castle cellar
detail: An empty bucket sits in the Lumbridge Castle cellar (basement); pick it up before heading out to the cow field.

label: Milk a dairy cow in the Lumbridge cow field
detail: Gather-not-GE alternative to the wiki's own 'buy from the Grand Exchange' shortcut (flagged GE-violation): use the bucket on a dairy cow in the Lumbridge cow field, just south of the castle.

label: Pick up an egg at the chicken coop
detail: Gather-not-GE alternative to the wiki's own 'buy from the Grand Exchange' shortcut (flagged GE-violation): an egg spawns at the chicken coop north-west of the cow field; pick one up.

label: Grab an empty pot from the Cook
detail: A spare empty pot sits by the Cook in Lumbridge Castle's kitchen.

label: Pick grain from the wheat field by Mill Lane Mill
detail: Grain grows in the wheat field just outside Mill Lane Mill, next to the cow pens.

label: Mill the grain into a pot of flour
detail: Climb to the top floor of Mill Lane Mill, use the grain on the hopper, then pull the lever. Climb back down and take the flour from the flour bin using the empty pot.

label: Deliver the milk, egg, and flour to the Cook
detail: Bring the bucket of milk, egg, and pot of flour to the Cook in Lumbridge Castle's kitchen and hand them over to finish the quest.

label: Talk to Kaqemeex (start Druidic Ritual)
detail: Kaqemeex stands in the stone circle north of Taverley; agree to help the druids reclaim the ritual site.

label: Talk to Sanfew in the Taverley Herb shop
detail: Sanfew is upstairs in Taverley's Herb shop; he explains the meat-enchanting ritual and asks for four raw meats.

label: Kill a bear for raw bear meat
detail: Gather-not-GE alternative to the wiki's own 'these meats can all be bought on the Grand Exchange' shortcut (flagged GE-violation): kill a bear near the building just west of Ice Mountain.

label: Kill a chicken for raw chicken
detail: Gather-not-GE alternative to the wiki's own GE-buy shortcut (flagged GE-violation): kill a chicken at the farm just south-east of Falador.

label: Kill a cow for raw beef
detail: Gather-not-GE alternative to the wiki's own GE-buy shortcut (flagged GE-violation): the same farm south-east of Falador also has a cow.

label: Kill a giant rat for raw rat meat
detail: Gather-not-GE alternative to the wiki's own GE-buy shortcut (flagged GE-violation): kill the giant rat near the graveyard just north of the church below Port Sarim.

label: Go to the Cauldron in Taverley Dungeon
detail: Enter Taverley Dungeon and head to the Cauldron room.

label: Enchant the four meats on the Cauldron
detail: Use each of the four raw meats (bear, rat, beef, chicken) on the Cauldron one at a time to enchant them. The Quick guide doesn't name the resulting item(s) distinctly from the raw meats -- treated as a 1:1 transform per meat, flagged "??" on exact post-enchant item naming.

label: Return the enchanted meats to Sanfew
detail: Bring the four enchanted meats back to Sanfew in the Taverley Herb shop.

label: Return to Kaqemeex to finish the quest
detail: Talk to Kaqemeex at the stone circle north of Taverley to complete Druidic Ritual and unlock Herblore training.

label: Talk to King Roald (start Priest in Peril)
detail: King Roald is in Varrock Palace; ask about a quest and he sends you to check on the missing priest Drezel.

label: Go to the temple east of Varrock, by the river
detail: Bring a ranged or melee weapon -- magic attacks and the Dwarf multicannon will not damage the Temple Guardian ahead.

label: Fight past the Temple Guardian
detail: Click the large door, climb down the trapdoor to the north, then kill the Temple Guardian blocking the way.

hints.note: Get it stuck in the middle section against the east wall, then stand one tile north on the east wall to safespot.

label: Report back to King Roald
detail: Go back to Varrock Palace and speak to King Roald again before returning to the temple.

label: Gather 25 unnoted essence
detail: Collect 25 unnoted pure or rune essence, plus a bucket, a weapon, and 1 free inventory slot. The Quick guide doesn't cite a specific essence-mine route here -- flagged "??". Low-level players may need two trips; the Monk of Zamorak ahead can be safespotted over the pews with ranged or magic.

label: Climb to Drezel's cell and talk to him
detail: Enter the temple again, go up the stairs then the ladder to the 2nd floor, and talk to Drezel through the cell bars.

label: Kill the Monk of Zamorak for a golden key
detail: Kill the level 30 Monk of Zamorak on the 1st floor of the temple to obtain a golden key.

label: Study the monuments for the one that takes the golden key
detail: Go back to the trapdoor where the Temple Guardian was fought, climb down, go through the first door, and check the monuments until finding the one the golden key fits.

hints.note: Which monument is the correct one isn't specified in the Quick guide -- check each until it fits.

label: Use the golden key on the monument
detail: Use the golden key on the correct monument to open it. The Quick guide doesn't explicitly narrate where the Iron key (used later on Drezel's cell door) comes from -- modeled as the contents of this monument since it's the only sourced key between here and the cell door; flagged for confirmation.

label: Fill the bucket at the well among the monuments
detail: Use the bucket on the well in the middle of the monument room. The Quick guide calls the result a 'blessed bucket of water' with no separate blessing step shown -- flagged "??" on the exact trigger, modeled as produced directly by filling the bucket here.

label: Unlock Drezel's cell and pour the water on the coffin
detail: Go back up to the top floor where Drezel is held. Use the Iron key on the cell door, talk to Drezel, then use the blessed bucket of water on the coffin in his cell.

label: Talk to Drezel again to start The River Salve
detail: Speak to Drezel once more at his cell to move into the final segment.

label: Go through the monument room's eastern door and talk to Drezel
detail: Go back down the trapdoor, through the monument room, and through the eastern door; Drezel is waiting there.

label: Gather 50 unnoted essence for Drezel
detail: Collect 50 unnoted pure or rune essence to hand over; without essence pouches this takes a few trips.

label: Give Drezel the 50 essence to finish the quest
detail: Hand the 50 unnoted essence to Drezel to complete Priest in Peril and unlock Morytania.

label: Talk to Asgarnia Smith at Bedabin Camp (start Desert Treasure)
detail: Asgarnia Smith stands by the magic carpet at Bedabin Camp; bring at least one free inventory slot and agree to help him.

label: Gather the starting materials Eblis needs
detail: Assemble 650 coins, ashes, a blood rune, bones, 6 molten glass, 12 magic logs, charcoal, and 6 steel bars via non-GE routes: bones from any kill, molten glass crafted from bucket-of-sand + soda-ash in a furnace, steel bars smithed from iron ore + coal, ashes from burning any logs. Blood rune sourcing (Runecrafting at the Blood Altar, or a monster drop) and magic-log sourcing (Woodcutting 75 on magic trees) and charcoal sourcing are not detailed in this quest's own Quick guide -- flagged "??", genuine gaps for Lane 5 rather than a GE substitution.

label: Get the book translated at the Digsite Exam Centre
detail: Go to the Digsite Exam Centre and talk to Terry Balando about the Desert Treasure quest, then talk to him again for a translation.

label: Show the translated book to Asgarnia Smith
detail: Return to Asgarnia Smith in the desert; tell him not to read the book, then talk to him again to have him help you.

label: Buy a drink at the Bandit Camp bar and ask about the diamonds
detail: Run south to the Bandit Camp and buy a drink in the pub for 650 coins (remove any Saradomin/Zamorak items first so the bandits don't attack). Talk to the bartender again and ask about the four diamonds.

label: Talk to Eblis about the four diamonds
detail: Find Eblis in or just outside the small rectangular building east of the bar; ask about the four diamonds of Azzanadra and agree to fetch them.

label: Deliver the gathered supplies to Eblis
detail: Use each required item (ashes, blood rune, bones, molten glass, magic logs, charcoal, steel bars) on Eblis, then talk to him again. Items can remain noted for this delivery.

label: Follow Eblis to the mirrors and begin the diamond hunt
detail: Go south-east to the mirrors and talk to Eblis there. The four diamonds (Smoke, Shadow, Ice, Blood) can be collected in any order; watch for a level 95 stranger who may randomly ambush you with a poisoned dragon dagger while carrying a diamond -- bank or place diamonds in the pyramid to avoid it.

label: Equip a facemask or gas mask
detail: Equip a facemask, gas mask, or Slayer helmet before entering the Smoke Dungeon.

label: Light the four torches and grab the warm key
detail: Enter the Smoke Dungeon (west of Pollnivneach, east of the mirrors). Light all four standing torches, one per corner, and open the centre chest for the warm key before any torch burns out. Starting NE then SE, NW, SW with 100% run avoids needing stamina potions.

label: Unlock the gate and kill Fareed for the Smoke diamond
detail: Use the warm key to open the gate east, then kill Fareed. Ice gloves are needed to wield melee gear (ranged works unarmoured but ash-es arrows), and only water spells damage him with Magic.

hints.note: Protect from Melee strongly advised; attack with a water spell or any ranged ammo.

label: Talk to Rasolo south of Baxtorian Falls
detail: Rasolo is outside his house south of Baxtorian Falls; ask about the Diamonds of Azzanadra.

label: Gather 20+ lockpicks and antipoison
detail: Gather-not-GE alternative to the wiki's own coin-exchange shortcut (flagged GE-violation): pickpocket bandits in the Bandit Camp vicinity for lockpicks and antipoison instead of exchanging noted coins with Tiles' general store.

label: Pick the secure chest and give the gilded cross to Rasolo
detail: In the southernmost Bandit Camp tent, pick all 3 locks on the secure chest consecutively (can take many tries, faster at higher Thieving) to get the gilded cross. Bring it back to Rasolo, who swaps it for a visibility ring even with a full inventory.

label: Equip the visibility ring and climb down
detail: Equip the visibility ring, then climb down the ladder east of Rasolo in the fenced area.

label: Kill Damis (both forms) for the Shadow diamond
detail: Run through the dungeon and kill Damis in both of his forms, then pick up the shadow diamond. His second form drains Prayer rapidly.

hints.note: Safespot by hitting a bat or rat and stacking NPCs behind you; don't run too far out of his range or he resets.

label: Gather sweet food and spiked boots
detail: Bring any sweet food from the Troll child's list, plus fire-spell runes. Get spiked boots from Dunstan by giving him a pair of climbing boots and an iron bar.

label: Give the troll child sweet food and enter the ice gate
detail: North-west of Trollheim, use the sweet food on the troll child, talk to it, then enter the ice gate.

label: Kill 5 ice trolls
detail: Kill 5 ice trolls guarding the gate; you won't need to re-kill them if you teleport out and return.

label: Follow the path and kill Kamil
detail: Enter the cave, follow the path, then fight Kamil. Only fire spells damage him with Magic (Iban Blast, Flames of Zamorak, and the trident's built-in spell do not work); your stats are constantly drained during the fight.

hints.note: Approach with Protect from Magic to force him to teleport into range, then switch to Protect from Melee.

label: Wear spiked boots, cross the ice ledge, and free the frozen trolls
detail: Continue west along the long icy path. Wear spiked boots to climb the ice ledge, follow the new path, go through the gate, then use a fire spell on each troll frozen in ice. Talk to them for the Ice diamond.

label: Talk to Malak in the Canifis pub
detail: Talk to Malak in the Canifis pub about the special diamond; ask how to kill Dessous.

label: Gather a silver bar, spice, and garlic powder
detail: Smelt a silver bar (silver ore in a furnace). Garlic can be searched from the cupboard upstairs in Morgan's house in Draynor; grind it with a pestle and mortar for garlic powder.

label: Get a silver pot made and enchanted
detail: Travel to the Draynor Sewer and give Ruantun the silver bar for a silver pot. Take the pot to the High Priest in the Entrana church (Entrana bans combat equipment) and he enchants it.

label: Talk to Malak again
detail: Return to Malak in the Canifis pub. He deals 5 damage during this conversation but cannot kill you.

label: Add spice and garlic powder to the pot of blood
detail: Add the spice and garlic powder to the pot Malak gives you to create a pot of blood. Prepare combat gear and prayer/healing supplies before the boss fight ahead.

label: Pour the blood on the tomb and kill Dessous
detail: Go to the Morytania Graveyard north of Castle Drakan, pour the pot of blood on the tomb, and defeat Dessous. He has 99 Defence and strong slash resistance -- range or mage him, alternating Protect from Melee/Missiles each tick to avoid damage.

label: Return to Malak and claim the Blood diamond
detail: Go back to Malak in the Canifis pub and claim the blood diamond. You keep the blessed pot even after leaving the fight (a new pot of blood is only needed if you leave mid-fight).

label: Place a diamond in each of the pyramid's obelisks
detail: Go south-east of Eblis and place the smoke, shadow, ice, and blood diamonds in the pyramid's obelisks.

label: Enter the pyramid and run each floor without stopping
detail: Enter the pyramid from the top and run through each floor without stopping -- traps may still trigger and can send you back to the start regardless. Mummies and Scarabs can hit over 20.

label: Talk to Azzanadra to finish the quest
detail: Talk to Azzanadra at the end of the pyramid to complete Desert Treasure and unlock the Ancient Magicks spellbook. Praying at his altar twice afterward unlocks a hard Desert-area task.

label: Talk to Ali Morrisane about his stock problems
detail: Talk to Ali Morrisane next to the Silk Stall in northern Al Kharid; ask why he's still selling from a stall to trigger the quest start.

hints.note: start: ask about his stock problems

label: Obtain a kharidian headpiece and a fake beard
detail: Buy a kharidian headpiece and a fake beard (NPC clothing stock in Al Kharid, not the Grand Exchange).

label: Combine the headpiece and beard into a desert disguise
detail: Use the kharidian headpiece on the fake beard to combine them into a desert disguise for the Pollnivneach infiltration later.

label: Travel to Pollnivneach
detail: Head south to Pollnivneach to begin the local investigation.

label: Buy 3 beers from Ali the Barman
detail: Buy 3 beers from Ali the Barman at the Pollnivneach bar (NPC purchase).

label: Ply Drunken Ali with 3 beers
detail: Use one beer on Drunken Ali at the bar, talk through the full dialogue, then repeat with the second and third beers -- do not skip any dialogue between beers.

label: Question the bandits and the Menaphite Thugs
detail: Talk to the bandits by the general store, then head west of the bar and question the Menaphite Thugs.

label: Travel to the camel store
detail: Head to the camel store just north-west of the bar.

label: Buy 2 camels from Ali the Camel Man
detail: Talk to Ali the Camel Man and buy 2 camels for 500 coins (NPC purchase); keep 2 free inventory slots first.

hints.note: haggle to 500 gold for the pair

label: Deliver camel receipts
detail: Talk to a Menaphite and a bandit, handing each of them a camel receipt.

label: Join Ali the Operator's gang
detail: Go to the large purple tent south-west of the bar and ask Ali the Operator to join his gang.

label: Demonstrate a pickpocket attempt
detail: Attempt to pickpocket a villager once (as a demonstration), then return to Ali the Operator for advice.

label: Pay the street urchin for a tip
detail: Talk to the street urchin near the centre town well and pay him 10 coins for a tip on which villager to target.

label: Pickpocket the marked villager
detail: Pickpocket the villager with an arrow marker over their head (the urchin's tip-off), then report back to Ali the Operator.

label: Obtain an oak blackjack
detail: Obtain an oak blackjack before continuing -- the walkthrough does not state an explicit source here ("??"); it is most likely supplied on joining Ali the Operator's gang, otherwise buy one from a Pollnivneach blackjack seller.

label: Equip the oak blackjack
detail: Equip the oak blackjack before approaching a villager.

label: Blackjack and pickpocket a villager
detail: Lure a villager into a secluded area, knock them out with the equipped oak blackjack, then pickpocket them while they're unconscious.

label: Report success, move to the jewels task
detail: Talk to Ali the Operator to move on to the jewel-theft task.

label: Equip the desert disguise and gloves
detail: Put on the desert disguise (made earlier) and a pair of gloves before infiltrating the mayor's house.

label: Hide behind the cactus near the mayor's house
detail: Hide behind the large cactus near the mayor's house, the large house to the east by the fountain.

label: Obtain the mayor's house keys
detail: Obtain the keys to the mayor's house -- the walkthrough does not state exactly how they're acquired here ("??"); they appear to be picked up automatically during the hide-behind-the-cactus sequence.

label: Enter the house and find the hidden dial
detail: Use the keys on the door, go up the stairs in the north-eastern corner, then search the landscape picture near the bed to reveal a hidden dial.

label: Crack the dial and take the jewels
detail: Hit the button on the dial to reset it, then click 1, 1, 2, 3, 5, 8 in that exact clockwise order to open the safe and take the jewels.

label: Hand over the jewels
detail: Give the recovered jewels to Ali the Operator.

label: Chase down the traitor lead
detail: Talk to Ali the Operator, then a Menaphite Thug, then Ali the Operator again, then Ali the Barman about "Traitorous Ali" -- a fixed dialogue chase with no branching outcome.

label: Buy special kebab sauce
detail: Buy special sauce from the kebab seller north-west of the well in the middle of town (NPC purchase).

label: Sabotage the trough behind the camel shop
detail: Use the special sauce on the trough behind the camel shop.

label: Collect Ugthanki dung
detail: Use a bucket on the dung behind the camel shop once it has turned brown; scoop 3 extra buckets of dung if also planning My Arm's Big Adventure later.

label: Get a snake charm and basket
detail: Use a coin on the snake charmer's money pot south of the bar, with 2 free inventory slots, to receive a snake charm and a snake basket.

hints.note: ask for a go with the snake charm

label: Capture a desert snake
detail: Use the snake charm repeatedly on a desert snake north of the Menaphite tent until it goes into the snake basket.

label: Travel to Ali the Hag
detail: Head to Ali the Hag, north-west of the kebab seller.

label: Trade the snake and dung for hag's poison
detail: Talk to Ali the Hag twice, handing over the filled snake basket and the Ugthanki dung to receive the hag's poison.

label: Poison the beer table
detail: Use the hag's poison on the table with a beer in the bar.

label: Report the traitor
detail: Talk to Ali the Operator to report what was found.

label: Prepare for battle and confront the Menaphite Leader
detail: Gear up for combat, then talk to the Menaphite Leader just outside the tent.

label: Kill the Tough Guy for a willow blackjack
detail: Kill the level-75 Tough Guy from a safe-spot behind the bush; he drops a willow blackjack.

label: Find and question the Bandit Leader
detail: Talk to a villager, then find and talk to the Bandit Leader, who wanders near the northern magic carpet station.

label: Kill the bandit champion for an adamant scimitar
detail: Kill the level-70 bandit champion from a safe-spot behind the chair in the house to the east, while holding the willow blackjack; he drops an adamant scimitar.

label: Report to Ali the Mayor
detail: Talk to a villager, then talk to Ali the Mayor by the well in the village centre.

label: Return to Ali Morrisane to finish the quest
detail: Return to Ali Morrisane, who you started the quest with, to complete The Feud.

label: Talk to Martin the Master Gardener
detail: Talk to Martin the Master Gardener in Draynor Village to start the quest.

hints.note: start: ask about the failing farm patches

label: Obtain secateurs and a spade if missing
detail: If you don't already have secateurs or a spade, buy them from Sarah in the building next to the Draynor cabbage patch (NPC purchase).

label: Confirm membership with Elstan
detail: Run north-west and talk to Elstan at the allotment/flower/herb patch; confirm he's a member of the Group of Advanced Gardeners.

label: Confirm membership with Frizzy Skernip
detail: Run south and talk to Frizzy Skernip; confirm his Group of Advanced Gardeners membership.

label: Travel to the Gnome Stronghold
detail: Take the spirit tree network (the Grand Exchange spirit tree is the fastest hop) to the Gnome Stronghold, then run east.

label: Confirm membership with Bolongo
detail: Talk to Bolongo and confirm his Group of Advanced Gardeners membership.

label: Confirm membership with Prissy Scilla
detail: Run south-west to the tree patch and talk to Prissy Scilla; confirm her membership.

label: Travel to Falador Park
detail: Teleport to Falador (Ring of wealth's Falador option lands directly in the park) and run to the tree patch.

label: Confirm membership with Heskel
detail: Talk to Heskel at the Falador Park tree patch; confirm his membership -- this completes the 5-gardener tally.

label: Report back to Martin
detail: Return to the Draynor Village market and talk to Martin again to move the quest forward.

label: Equip a dramen staff or Lunar staff
detail: Equip a dramen staff or Lunar staff -- required to enter Zanaris; source of the staff itself is outside this quest's own walkthrough ("??" if not already owned from Lost City).

label: Travel to Zanaris
detail: Enter the small shack south of Lumbridge Castle in Lumbridge Swamp with the staff equipped to teleport to Zanaris; if the quest spade still needs collecting, enter once without the staff equipped first to grab it.

label: Ask the Fairy Godfather about the Fairy Queen
detail: Run to the throne room and talk to the Fairy Godfather; ask where the Fairy Queen is.

label: Get the symptoms list from Fairy Nuff
detail: Run north of the bank and talk to Fairy Nuff to receive the Fairy Queen's symptoms list.

label: Consult Zandar Horfyre
detail: Speak to Zandar Horfyre on the top floor of the Dark Wizards' Tower, just north of the Makeover Mage.

label: Fill a druid pouch (recommended)
detail: Fill a druid pouch before collecting the 3 random items -- it protects any of them that ghasts could otherwise turn to rotten food. Recommended, not strictly required.

label: Dig up a Draynor skull if needed
detail: If you don't already have a Draynor skull, travel to Draynor Manor and use a spade on the grave north of the building, within the fence, to dig one up.

label: Trade the skull for the collection list
detail: Talk to Malignius Mortifer, the necromancer north-west of Port Sarim's rune shop; give him the Draynor skull to receive the list of 3 required items. Buy secateurs/spade from the nearby farm shop if still missing.

label: Collect the 3 randomly-assigned items
detail: Collect the 3 randomly-picked items per your quest journal's list -- the exact items vary per playthrough ("??"); carry the filled druid pouch while gathering any that ghasts could rot.

label: Travel to the Nature Grotto
detail: Travel to the Nature Grotto in Mort Myre Swamp via the Shades of Mort'ton minigame teleport, go west, then follow the winding path north over the bridge.

label: Equip the Ghostspeak amulet
detail: Equip the Ghostspeak amulet before entering the grotto so the Nature Spirit can be understood.

label: Trade the items for the Magic secateurs
detail: Talk to the Nature Spirit inside the grotto and hand over the 3 collected items to receive the Magic secateurs.

label: Bring food and armour for the Tanglefoot fight
detail: Bring food and armour before returning to Zanaris to face the Tanglefoot.

label: Return to Zanaris with the Magic secateurs
detail: Travel to Zanaris with the Magic secateurs in your inventory.

label: Squeeze through the gap by the Cosmic Altar
detail: Run south of the wheat fields to the Cosmic Altar and squeeze through the gap in the western wall.

label: Equip the Magic secateurs
detail: Equip the Magic secateurs before entering the tunnel.

label: Defeat the Tanglefoot
detail: Run to the end of the tunnel and defeat Tanglefoot; toggle Protect from Melee if the level allows, or lure it around the mushrooms to the east to flinch it.

label: Pick up the Queen's secateurs
detail: Pick up the Queen's secateurs dropped by Tanglefoot.

label: Finish the quest with the Fairy Godfather
detail: Talk to the Fairy Godfather to complete Fairytale I - Growing Pains.

label: Talk to Curator Haig Halen
detail: Speak to Curator Haig Halen in the Varrock Museum and agree to help finish the barge.

hints.note: start: offer to help finish the barge

label: Travel to the canal barge
detail: Go to the canal barge north of the Digsite.

label: Talk to the barge foreman
detail: Talk to the barge foreman at the canal barge.

label: Get the sawmill proposal
detail: Talk to the sawmill operator in the Lumber Yard, explaining you're there on behalf of the museum archaeological team.

label: Deliver the sawmill proposal
detail: Bring the sawmill proposal to the sawmill operator in the Woodcutting Guild; if entry requirements aren't met, simply try opening the guild's eastern gate to satisfy this step.

label: Deliver the signed agreement
detail: Bring the sawmill agreement back to the Lumber Yard's sawmill operator.

label: Report back to the barge foreman
detail: Talk to the barge foreman again.

label: Board the barge
detail: Right-click the Embark option on the barge guard to board the barge.

label: Talk to the Lead Navigator
detail: Talk to the Lead Navigator aboard the barge.

label: Travel to the Rusty Anchor Inn
detail: Travel to the Rusty Anchor Inn in Port Sarim.

label: Ask Jack Seagull about cursed voyages
detail: Talk to Jack Seagull in the Rusty Anchor Inn about cursed voyages.

label: Re-board the barge
detail: Return to the northern part of the Digsite and board the boat again through the barge guard.

label: Talk to the Lead Navigator again
detail: Talk to the Lead Navigator once more.

label: Get the Bone charm from the Odd Old Man
detail: Deboard, walk west then north then east to the limestone mine, and speak to the Odd Old Man about lucky charms and the cursed voyage; he gives a Bone charm.

label: Obtain 2 bottles of vodka
detail: Obtain 2 bottles of vodka -- the walkthrough does not state a sourcing method here ("??"); no Grand Exchange purchase is used regardless.

label: Gather a marrentill herb
detail: Gather a marrentill herb (Herblore farming patch or a common secondary monster drop).

label: Fill a vial with water
detail: Fill an empty vial with water from any water source.

label: Make a Marrentill potion (unf)
detail: Use the marrentill herb on the vial of water to produce a Marrentill potion (unf).

label: Bring the vodka and potion to the Apothecary
detail: Bring the 2 vodka bottles and the Marrentill potion (unf) to the Apothecary in Varrock; select 'Talk about something else' then 'Talk about Bone Voyage'.

label: Receive the potion of sealegs
detail: Speak to the Apothecary again, selecting the same chat options as before, to receive the potion of sealegs.

label: Deliver the potion of sealegs
detail: Return to the Lead Navigator and give him the potion of sealegs.

label: Hand over the bone charm and depart
detail: Speak to the Junior Navigator, give him the bone charm, and confirm you're ready to go.

label: Steer the barge to Fossil Island
detail: Click the arrow opposite whichever way the top arrow tilts to correct course, and keep the sails as large as possible in a straight line for steadier travel, until the progress bar fills and you arrive at Fossil Island.

label: Talk to Herman Caranos
detail: Talk to Herman Caranos at the Piscatoris Fishing Colony, north of fairy ring code AKQ; the offered cutscene is optional.

hints.note: start: agree to fight the sea trolls

label: Gather blood, mist, and lava runes
detail: Gather 5 blood runes, 10 mist runes, and 10 lava runes before visiting the Wise Old Man.

label: Talk to the Wise Old Man
detail: Talk to the Wise Old Man in Draynor Village, handing over the gathered runes.

label: Bring combat supplies for the Sea Trolls
detail: Bring food, armour, a melee or ranged weapon, and prayer potions to fight the Sea Trolls guarding the colony.

label: Return to the Colony with the Wise Old Man
detail: Return to the Fishing Colony and talk to the Wise Old Man.

label: Fight through the Sea Trolls into the Colony
detail: Kill the level-79 Sea Trolls blocking the entrance and collect 7 of their bones if needed for later; note that after 1-3 kills the trolls switch to dropping only big bones, which don't count toward that requirement.

label: Talk to Herman in the east building
detail: Talk to Herman inside the east building -- click inside the building itself, not directly on Herman, or your character will run back outside.

label: Gather repair materials
detail: Bring logs, a tinderbox (or get one from Franklin), 5 iron bars, a hammer (or get one from Franklin), a small fishing net (or get one from Arnold), and level-boosting items if below Fishing 62 or Smithing 45.

label: Talk to Franklin Caranos
detail: Talk to Franklin Caranos near the colony entrance to begin repairs.

label: Light the firebox
detail: Use a log on the firebox -- not the furnace -- and light it, inside the building marked with the furnace symbol; Franklin supplies a tinderbox if asked again.

label: Press iron sheets
detail: Use each of the 5 iron bars on the Metal Press to produce iron sheets.

label: Repair the western perimeter wall
detail: Use the iron sheets to repair the western colony perimeter's broken walls; Franklin supplies a hammer if asked.

label: Talk to Arnold Lydspor
detail: Talk to Arnold Lydspor in the bank; he supplies a small fishing net if you don't already have one.

label: Fish 5 fresh monkfish
detail: Fish 5 fresh monkfish at the spot to the north-west, catching a few extra in case some burn while cooking.

label: Optionally fight spawning Sea Trolls
detail: Optionally kill Sea Trolls as they spawn nearby while fishing; after 1-3 kills they only drop big bones, which no longer count toward the earlier bones requirement.

label: Cook the monkfish
detail: Cook the monkfish in the kitchen south of the fishing spot; note that Arnold's bank cannot be used to access cooking gauntlets here.

label: Deliver the cooked monkfish to Arnold
detail: Talk to Arnold and hand over the cooked monkfish.

label: Report back to Franklin
detail: Talk to Franklin again.

label: Report to the Wise Old Man and Herman
detail: Talk to the Wise Old Man and Herman in the far eastern building.

label: Gather bones, an airtight pot, and a brown apron
detail: Gather 7 bones (from the earlier Sea Troll kills), an airtight pot OR a pot with a pot lid, and a brown apron (or ask Malignius for one); if not banking afterward also bring food, armour, a weapon, and prayer potions.

label: Travel to the Wizards' Guild basement
detail: Travel to the basement of the Wizards' Guild in Yanille; the Nightmare Zone minigame teleport is needed to leave the colony first.

label: Talk to Wizard Frumscone
detail: Talk to Wizard Frumscone and agree to help the necromancer.

label: Portal to the Dark Wizards' Tower
detail: Use the southern portal on the guild's 2nd floor to teleport to the Dark Wizards' Tower, near Malignius Mortifer.

label: Get a brown apron from Malignius Mortifer
detail: Talk to Malignius Mortifer, south of Falador, about saving the fishing colony; receive a brown apron for Crafting Guild entry.

label: Talk to the Master Crafter
detail: Talk to the Master Crafter with dreadlocks on the east side of the Crafting Guild.

label: Make a pot and pot lid
detail: If carrying soft clay, use it on the potter's wheel then the potter's oven to produce a pot and pot lid; if carrying a pickaxe instead, mine clay first then follow the same steps.

label: Assemble the airtight pot
detail: Combine the pot and pot lid into an airtight pot.

label: Remove Saradomin-affiliated gear
detail: Remove any Saradomin-affiliated gear before continuing -- Malignius refuses to hand over bone seeds while it's worn or held, and dropping gear here isn't advisable since you'll be teleported away shortly.

label: Collect bone seeds and teleport back
detail: Talk to Malignius Mortifer to receive the bone seeds and teleport back to the Fishing Colony.

label: Bring supplies for the Final Battle
detail: Bring food, armour, a melee or ranged weapon, prayer potions, and the bone seeds to the final fight.

label: Begin the fight with Herman
detail: Talk to Herman to begin the final battle.

label: Defeat the Sea Troll Queen
detail: Fight the Sea Troll Queen; use Protect from Magic while in melee range, and Ranged or Melee to deal damage.

label: Finish the quest with Herman
detail: Talk to Herman to complete Swan Song.

label: Optionally cook a diary monkfish
detail: Optionally catch and cook another monkfish afterward -- satisfies a hard Western Provinces Achievement Diary task.
